## Review

**7 out of 10, Effective.** Presentation quality, judged with the SlideDeck Co review heuristic (https://slidedeck.co/review-methodology/). The ask, the evidence and the merit of the idea are not rated.

The deck has a clear route: a Vision 2022 scorecard on slides 6 and 7, five success drivers, market context, then Vision 2027 with a repeating four-pillar divider (slides 21, 22, 35, 51, 69) that keeps an 84-page investor deck navigable. Action titles, a consistent yellow and red palette, and clean charts such as slide 6 make most pages readable, and the photo-led store pages add real visual interest. Weaknesses are consequential: slide 28 has no price axis labels so the ladder cannot be read, slide 18 mixes shades and tiny labels, and the animation-step duplicates (slides 38 and 39, 43, 46, 49) and the full-bleed photo runs (slides 61 to 68) add pages with no argument. Many mid-deck slides carry small body text and dense charts that suit a read-ahead document more than a live room.

**Worth keeping:** Keep the scorecard format on slides 6 and 7 with the target and actual bars and the green check callouts, and the highlighted pillar divider that tells the audience where they are in the Vision 2027 section.

**Most useful repair:** Remove the build-step duplicates on slides 38, 39, 43, 46 and 49, add price values or a labelled axis to the ladder on slide 28, and caption or trim the unlabelled store photo run so each image carries a point.

**What would change the score:** I would raise the smallest chart labels and body text on slides 10 to 12, 18 and 57 to a size readable in a room, and reduce text on the densest slides to one message each.

_Confidence medium. 72 of 84 pages inspected on contact sheets, 4 at readable size. Reviewed Reviewed 2026-11-08. Model-assisted review (claude-sonnet-5-5)._

## Summary

The deck opens with a title slide for the Strategy Day held on December 1, 2022, followed by a safe harbour disclosure and a short note on the company's new name. It then sets out the vision and mission, values, and the success enablers that underpin the strategy. A scorecard reviews performance against the earlier Vision 2022 targets on sales, profitability, and network expansion. Five success drivers follow: menu management, omnichannel, network expansion, cost saving, and capital efficiency. The middle sections cover industry trends, the foodservice market structure, and a menu strategy built around burgers, chicken, and coffee. The deck then presents Vision 2027 across four pillars: meals leadership, omnichannel, network expansion, and operating performance. It closes with long-term value creation levers, governance and leadership, ESG initiatives, and a summary of 2027 targets with a thank-you and investor relations contact. Slides worth studying include the Vision 2022 scorecard on slides 6 and 7, the pricing ladder on slide 28, and the market construct on slide 18.

## Questions about this deck

**What are the four pillars of the Vision 2027 strategy in the Westlife Foodworld deck?**

Slide 21 sets out Vision 2027 across four pillars: Meals Strategy, Omnichannel Strategy, Faster than ever Network Expansion, and Lead with performance. Each pillar has a short description of its aim on the same slide.

**How many slides does the Westlife Foodworld presentation have?**

The Westlife Foodworld deck has 84 pages. Slide 1 is the title slide for the Strategy Day held on December 1, 2022.

**What does the Westlife Foodworld deck say about revenue against the Vision 2022 target?**

Slide 6, the Vision 2022 Score Card for sales and profitability, shows revenue of 20.4 Rs. billions for TTM Sep 2022 against a Vision 2022 target of 20-25 Rs. billions. The same slide shows FY16 revenue of 8.3 Rs. billions.

**What market size does the Westlife Foodworld deck give for Indian foodservice?**

Slide 18, titled Indian Foodservice Market Construct and Opportunity, states that Informal Eating Out is an INR ~3.2 tn market. The slide shows the split as Unorganised 68% and Organised 32%, with data as of 2021.

shareholders
”
Success Enablers
Building Blocks
Execution
Proficiency
Strategic
Proficiency

Values

Integrity

Family
4

**Layout**

Single 16:9 slide with a left-aligned bold title at top-left (x 3.5%, y 6%), a westlife logo at top-right corner, and a centred two-line-plus quotation block below the title. Below the quote, a green-outlined panel 'Success Enablers' spans the width with four equal coloured pills in one row, and beneath it a grey-outlined 'Values' panel holds five centred icon-and-label columns separated by thin vertical dividers. Yellow rules run along the top and bottom edges; the slide number sits bottom-right at x 98.8%, y 97%.

**Visuals**

Four icon-and-label pills in the Success Enablers panel: (1) white line icon of three stacked cubes beside 'Building Blocks' on red #C00000; (2) white line icon of a gear with a check mark beside 'Execution Proficiency' on brown #947356; (3) white line icon of a gear with a chess piece and star beside 'Strategic Proficiency' on amber #FFBC0D; (4) white line icon of two hands holding a star beside 'Talent Proficiency' on dark gold #C99100. Five value icons in the Values panel: Serve, a pair of hands forming a heart, one orange-tan and one brown, with red and yellow cuffs; Inclusion, three stylised people in a triangle (orange top, green, brown, red and tan figures); Integrity, a yellow compass rose with a red and yellow needle and small green and blue points; Community, a yellow house roof over three figures in yellow, light blue, maroon and red; Family, a yellow stool with a red centre bar and light blue and green legs. Quote marks are red Speedee bold glyphs. Logo: westlife wordmark in black serif with a purple, green and magenta leaf mark above the 'f'. No photographs, charts or tables; all imagery is flat vector icons, unshadowed and unboxed.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF.

### Slide 5

**Text**

Recap of Vision 2022
GROW MARKET SHARE &
MARGIN
BROADENING ACCESSIBILITY
OF BRAND MCDONALD'S
GROW BASELINE SALES
• Sales of Rs 20 bn – Rs 25 bn
• Take EBITDA margin to low to
mid teens
• Restaurant level cash on cash
returns of >20%
• High single digit SSSG%
• McCafé: 75 to 300-350
• McDelivery: 124 to 300-325
• 80-100 EoTF restaurants
• Leverage other models and
menu in the future
• 400 – 500 restaurants
Presence in 45+ cities
• Investment of Rs 5+ billion
5

**Layout**

Three-column layout on a white slide with a light grey band spanning the full width between about 18% and 89% of the slide height. The title sits top-left at about 6% from the top and 3.5% from the left, with a Westlife logo in the top-right corner. Each column has a bold uppercase heading, a yellow rule, a centred icon, a second yellow rule and a bulleted list left-aligned under the rule; a black equals sign sits between columns 1 and 2 and a black plus sign between columns 2 and 3. The slide number sits bottom-right; yellow bars run along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Three flat icons in red (#D92027) and yellow (#FFC000). Left icon: a red donut chart with a segment separated by a gap and one segment filled with yellow diagonal stripes on white. Centre icon: a red rising arrow over three red rounded-rectangle bars of increasing height, with a yellow circle containing a red dollar sign above the tallest bar. Right icon: a red map pin containing a white and yellow burger, with red dashed motion lines on either side of the pin's tip. Between columns 1 and 2 a solid black equals sign made of two horizontal bars. Between columns 2 and 3 a solid black plus sign. Top-right logo: the Westlife wordmark in black serif lowercase with a multicoloured leaf mark (purple, green, yellow) above it.

**Design**

Background white (#FFFFFF) with a light grey band #F2F2F2 across the middle. Thin yellow bars (#FFC000) along the top and bottom edges and as rules beneath each column heading and below each icon. Title in Speedee-Bold, black #000000, about 5.9% of slide height. Column headings in Speedee-Bold uppercase, dark grey #404040, about 3.0% of slide height. Body text in Speedee-Regular dark grey #404040 with bold keywords in Speedee-Bold, about 2.6% of slide height, line spacing about 1.8 times the font size. Bullets are small grey round bullets in Arial. Slide number in Speedee-Regular grey #7F7F7F, about 1.8% of slide height. Shapes are flat with no shadows or gradients; icons have rounded corners.

### Slide 6

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: Scorecard places each Vision 2022 target beside the actual result, making progress easy to read at a glance.
- Review: The deck has a clear route: a Vision 2022 scorecard on slides 6 and 7, five success drivers, market context, then Vision 2027 with a repeating four-pillar divider (slides 21, 22, 35, 51, 69) that keeps an 84-page investor deck navigable.
- Review: Action titles, a consistent yellow and red palette, and clean charts such as slide 6 make most pages readable, and the photo-led store pages add real visual interest.
- Worth keeping: Keep the scorecard format on slides 6 and 7 with the target and actual bars and the green check callouts, and the highlighted pillar divider that tells the audience where they are in the Vision 2027 section.

**Layout**

Title sits top-left at about 6% from the top with a left margin of about 3.5%, set on one line, with the Westlife logo in the top-right corner. Five charts are arranged in a grid: three across the upper row (Revenue, SSSG, AUV) and two centred across the lower row (Op. EBITDA Margin, Restaurant Cash Returns), each with a header, a three-bar chart, a baseline and a grey callout strip beneath it with a green check badge at its right end. Page number sits bottom-right at about 98.8% from the left and 97% from the top, with yellow bars framing the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Five vertical bar charts, each with three bars sharing a flat baseline, no axes, gridlines or legend. Bars are labelled with values inside or above them and the category labels sit under the baseline. Chart 1 'Revenue, Rs. billions': FY16 8.3 (pale yellow bar), Vision 2022 20-25 (yellow bar), TTM Sep 2022 20.4 (red bar). Chart 2 'SSSG, Percent': FY11-16 ~0% (no bar, value label only), Vision 2022 'High single digits' (yellow bar, text inside), FY16-22 8.5% (red bar, tallest of this chart). Chart 3 'AUV, Rs. Millions': FY16 39 (pale yellow), Vision 2022 60 (yellow), TTM Sep 2022 63 (red). Chart 4 'Op. EBITDA Margin, percent': FY16 5.9% (pale yellow), Vision 2022 'Low to mid teens' (yellow, text inside), TTM Sep 2022 12.8% (red). Chart 5 'Restaurant Cash Returns, Percent': FY16 15% (pale yellow), Vision 2022 >20% (yellow), TTM Sep 2022 30% (red). Highlighted points: the TTM Sep 2022 bars are red in every chart. Five green circular check badges (about 3% by 5.3%) with white check marks sit at the right end of each callout strip, one per chart. The Westlife logo (a multicoloured leaf above the wordmark) is in the top-right corner.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white slide with a flat, minimal corporate look. Title in Speedee Bold (geometric humanist sans-serif) for the lead phrase and Speedee Regular for the rest, black #000000, about 5.9% of slide height for the cap-height box. Chart headers are Speedee Bold in dark grey #555555 for the measure name and Speedee Regular in #555555 for the unit, about 3.0% of slide height. Body and category labels are Speedee Regular #595959 at about 2.2% of slide height. Callout text is Speedee Italic #000000 about 2.2%. Value labels are Speedee Bold, #404040 on pale and yellow bars and #FFFFFF on red bars. Accents: yellow #FFBC0D, red #DB0007, pale yellow #FFE49E, green check badges, tan header rules and grey header rules. Bars are flat with square corners and no shadows. Callout strips are flat light grey with no border. Top and bottom edge bars are solid yellow #FFBC0D about 0.4% of slide height thick.

### Slide 7

**Review notes**

- Review: The deck has a clear route: a Vision 2022 scorecard on slides 6 and 7, five success drivers, market context, then Vision 2027 with a repeating four-pillar divider (slides 21, 22, 35, 51, 69) that keeps an 84-page investor deck navigable.
- Worth keeping: Keep the scorecard format on slides 6 and 7 with the target and actual bars and the green check callouts, and the highlighted pillar divider that tells the audience where they are in the Vision 2027 section.

**Text**

Vision 2022 Score Card: Network expansion / westlife / Number of stores / 400-500 / 337 / 236 / FY16 / Vision 2022 / As on Sep 2022 / Pace slowed during Covid, but on track now / Number of cities / 52 / 45+ / 30 / FY16 / Vision 2022 / As on Sep 2022 / Expansion into smaller towns / Investment, Rs. Billions / 5.2+ / 5+ / 4.7 / FY 11-16 / Vision 2022 / Last 5y / Consistent investments in store network / Number of McCafés / Penetration / 81% / 70-75% / 300-350 / 274 / 32% / 75 / FY16 / Vision 2022 / As on Sep 2022 / Achieved the targeted penetration levels / EOTF restaurants / Penetration / 48%* / 138 / 80-100 / 0 / FY16 / Vision 2022 / As on Sep 2022 / Rapid expansion of EOTF stores / * Percentage of total eligible store base / McDelivery restaurants / Penetration / 87% / 65-75% / 300-325 / 292 / 53% / 124 / FY16 / Vision 2022 / As on Sep 2022 / Achieved the targeted penetration levels / 7

**Layout**

Six panels in a 3-column by 2-row grid with equal column gutters and no outer frame. The title sits top-left at about 6% from the top, left-aligned at x 3.5%, with the westlife logo top-right at x 91.4%. Each panel has a bold grey heading centred over a rule, a bar chart with category labels under the bars, and a grey italic takeaway strip with a check icon at its right end. A footnote is centred below the bottom row and the page number sits bottom-right; yellow strips run along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Six simple vertical bar charts with no axes, gridlines or y-scale; the x-axis is a thin light grey baseline under each chart with category labels beneath. Panel 1 'Number of stores': FY16 236 (light yellow bar), Vision 2022 400-500 (yellow bar), As on Sep 2022 337 (red bar). Panel 2 'Number of cities': FY16 30 (light yellow), Vision 2022 45+ (yellow), As on Sep 2022 52 (red, tallest bar in its panel). Panel 3 'Investment, Rs. Billions': FY 11-16 4.7 (light yellow), Vision 2022 5+ (yellow), Last 5y 5.2+ (red). Panel 4 'Number of McCafés' has two series: store counts FY16 75 (light yellow), Vision 2022 300-350 (yellow), As on Sep 2022 274 (red); and penetration callouts 32%, 70-75%, 81%, with a 'Penetration' label box at the upper left. Panel 5 'EOTF restaurants': FY16 0 (no bar, label sits on baseline), Vision 2022 80-100 (yellow), As on Sep 2022 138 (red, tallest); penetration callout 48%* sits above the red bar, with a 'Penetration' label box at upper left. Panel 6 'McDelivery restaurants': FY16 124 (light yellow), Vision 2022 300-325 (yellow), As on Sep 2022 292 (red); penetration callouts 53%, 65-75%, 87%, with a 'Penetration' label box at upper left. Bar values are printed inside or on top of bars; no estimates are needed except the FY16 bars of panel 4 and panel 6, whose heights are about read from the image. Highlighted points: none beyond the colour coding by series. Legend: none. Colour coding: light yellow = FY16 or earliest year, yellow = Vision 2022 target, red = as on Sep 2022 or latest. Penetration callouts are white rounded rectangles with tan outlines, sitting over the bars. Check icons: grey check circle (stores), green check circles (cities, investment, EOTF), tan/beige check circles (McCafés, McDelivery). Logo: westlife wordmark with a multicoloured leaf icon (purple, teal, green, red) top-right. Footnote asterisk note is text only.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with yellow #FFBC0D strips along the top and bottom edges. White background. Yellow #FFBC0D strips about 0.4% of slide height along the top and bottom edges. Title text black #000000, with 'Vision 2022 Score Card:' in bold and 'Network expansion' in regular weight, sans-serif (Speedee family, a geometric-humanist sans), title size about 5.9% of slide height. Panel headings bold #555555 at about 3.0% of height. Body and axis labels regular #595959 at about 2.2%. Bar value labels bold #404040 on yellow and light yellow bars, bold white #FFFFFF on red bars. Takeaway text italic black #000000 at about 2.2%. Heading rules are 0.4% thick: tan #C4A484 for stores, Investment, McCafés and McDelivery, mid grey #8C8C8C for cities and EOTF. Takeaway strips are flat #F2F2F2 rectangles with no corner radius and no shadow. Bars are flat rectangles with no outline. Penetration callouts are white at 58% opacity with thin tan #B8956A outlines and slightly rounded corners. Accent colours: red #DB0007, yellow #FFBC0D, light yellow #FFE49E. Footnote italic about 1.5%; page number regular #7F7F7F about 1.8%.

### Slide 8

**Text**

Success drivers
2
Omnichannel
approach
4
Cost
optimization
1
Menu

expansion

efficiency

**Layout**

Two-row wave of five numbered steps on a white panel inside a thick yellow border. The title 'Success drivers' sits top-left at about 3.5% from the left edge and 6% from the top. Five steps alternate left to right: numbers 2 and 4 with headings above the wave, numbers 1, 3 and 5 with headings below it. Each step is centred on a circle of equal size, spaced evenly across the width. There is no footer, and the slide number '8' sits in the bottom-right corner on the yellow border.

**Visuals**

Five-step wave graphic with no chart data. Five thick semicircular arc bands, each about 19.3% wide and 17.1% high, form a continuous S-shaped wave running left to right. Arc colours step from dark gold #C99100 (step 1) through bright yellow #FFBC0D, light gold #FFD76E and pale yellow #FFE49E to very pale cream #FFF2CF (step 5). Each arc band is a solid fill with flat ends, and the arcs join where they meet. Five solid circles sit in the troughs and crests of the wave, each about 10% wide and 17.7% high, filled with the same colour sequence as the arcs. Each circle holds a black line-art icon (outline strokes, no fill): icon 1 is a fast-food meal with a burger, a soda cup with straw and a carton of fries; icon 2 is a delivery rider on a scooter with a parcel box; icon 3 is a storefront with a striped awning, a door, a window and a small table with a stool; icon 4 is two downward arrows above a dollar coin; icon 5 is a gear enclosing an upward bar chart. Step numbers are outlined numerals in a fill that matches each step's colour, with a thin dark outline: 1 in #C99100, 2 in #FFBC0D, 3 in #FFD76E, 4 in #FFE49E, 5 in #FFF2CF.

**Design**

Background: Solid #FFBC0D yellow frame around a white #FFFFFF inner panel. White inner panel with a solid #FFBC0D yellow border about 2% wide on the left and right and about 3.3% at top and bottom. Title and body text are pure black #000000 in a heavy bold geometric sans-serif (Speedee-Bold), with no italics or capitals. The step numbers are small bold rounded sans-serif numerals, outlined. Accents use a yellow-to-cream palette from #C99100 to #FFF2CF. Shapes have no shadows, gradients or rounded corners beyond the circular forms.

Two-column slide: a left column holding a horizontal bar chart (about 0 to 40% of slide width for the chart area, from x 1.7% to 44%) and a right column of three stacked rounded cards (x 42.5% to 92.2%), with a vertical black tab labelled Snacking Leadership at the far right (x 93.6% to 97.1%). The title sits top-left at y 6.9% beside a section number '1' and a vertical yellow rule, left-aligned at x 5.6%. A section tag sits in the top-left corner, the Westlife logo sits top-right, and the note line sits bottom-left at y 95.5%. The page number '10' sits bottom-right at x 98.4%, y 97.0%. Margins are about 1.5 to 3% on each side.

**Visuals**

Horizontal bar chart titled 'Average Sales Per Store, Rs. millions' (the Rs. millions unit label is in regular weight). Categories top to bottom: FY16 (bar value 39, brown #947056-like fill, starts at baseline), Core Burgers (increment 6, yellow), Combos & Meals (increment 8, yellow), McCafe (increment 5, yellow), Gourmet + Chicken (increment 4, yellow), Others (increment 1, yellow, very thin), Current (value 63, red #DB0007 full bar from baseline). Bars are floating increments for the four-to-six yellow bars, each offset to the right of the baseline, with value labels inside or beside each bar. Value labels: 39 (white, inside brown bar), 6, 8, 5, 4, 1 (dark, in yellow), 63 (white, inside red bar). No axis ticks, no numeric scale, no gridlines; a thin grey vertical baseline at x about 23.5%. A green dashed rounded rectangle (#00A651-like green, about 1.5 pt dashes) encloses the Core Burgers, Combos & Meals and McCafe rows and runs from x 1.5% to 36.5%, y 19.5% to 62%. A white callout box with a green border (#00A651-like, about 1 pt) reads '80% of incremental AUV' and has a green connector line from its bottom edge to the dashed box at x about 36.5%. Legend: none. Highlighted points: the dashed green group and the red Current bar. Photographs: a burger photo (two burgers, one McSpicy-style patty with cheese and tomato on a white wrapper, with lettuce and onion, on a plain white background, soft even lighting, cutout, no overlay, neatly boxed without border) beside the Core Burgers card; a photo of a McSaver-style burger with fries and a McAloo-style wrap on a white background beside the Combos and Meals card; a photo of three McCafe mugs (brown, with latte art), a pancake and a breakfast sandwich, warm lighting, on white, beside the Coffee card. The Westlife logo is a green-and-purple leaf above the wordmark 'westlife' in black serif type.

**Layout**

Two-column layout on a white field: a narrow left column (about x 0 to 40) holds a horizontal bar chart with its heading and axis; a right column (about x 42 to 98) holds two stacked rounded-rectangle panels, On-premise Strategy above Off-premise Strategy, each with a yellow pill heading, bullet text and a small column chart. The slide title sits top-left at y about 7, left-aligned after a yellow '2' section number and a divider bar, below a small yellow 'Success drivers' tag; a westlife logo sits top-right. A footnote sits bottom-left at y about 95.5 and the page number bottom-right at y about 97; thin yellow rules frame the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Horizontal bar chart titled Average Sales Per Store, Rs. millions (unit Rs. millions, no printed axis scale or range; the category axis is a vertical grey line at about x 15.5). Categories top to bottom with labelled values: FY16 39 (brown bar #947356, white label inside bar); In Store 3 (small yellow bar #FFBC0D, label 3 beside it); Delivery 20 (yellow bar #FFBC0D, label 20 inside); Drive-thru + OTG 1 (thin yellow bar, label 1 to its right); Current 63 (red bar #DB0007, white label inside, the bar is about 15 percent of width). A green dashed rectangle (#00A651 style green) highlights the In Store and Delivery rows. No legend. Right top chart On-Premise Digital Sales: two columns on a thin grey baseline, FY16 labelled 0% with no bar, Current a tall red column #DB0007 labelled 30-35% in white bold italic at its top. Right bottom chart Off-premise Contribution: FY16 yellow column #FFBC0D about 11% (short, label above it, values about 11 percent), Current red column #DB0007 labelled 44%, both on a thin grey baseline. Photograph: a self-ordering kiosk at the McDonald's-style restaurant, a white floor-standing kiosk with a vertical touchscreen showing burger menu images and a card reader below, beside a tall yellow sign reading ORDER HERE in black vertical letters, with a glass window and warm wood-toned interior behind; warm lighting; dominant colours white, yellow and brown; cropped to a tall rectangle with small rounded corners. Logo: red circle with yellow M arches and a dotted white trail, with McDelivery wordmark in black below it. Logo: westlife, a multicoloured stylised leaf (purple, green and orange) above a black lowercase wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF. Titles and headings in black #000000 bold sans-serif, approximately the Speedee family (geometric humanist sans), bold weight; slide title about 5.4 percent of slide height, body text about 2.6 percent, footnote and page number about 1.8 percent. Accent yellow #FFBC0D for section number, pills, divider and yellow bars; red #DB0007 for Current bars; brown #947356 for FY16 bar; grey #555555 and #595959 for chart labels and subtitles; #404040 for in-bar values; green dashed highlight. Panels are rounded rectangles with a black outline of about 0.2 percent of slide height and large corner radius; heading pills are fully rounded yellow bars with bold black text. No shadows, no gradients. Thin yellow rules along top and bottom edges.

### Slide 12

**Review notes**

- What would change the score: I would raise the smallest chart labels and body text on slides 10 to 12, 18 and 57 to a size readable in a room, and reduce text on the densest slides to one message each.

**Text**

Success drivers / 3 / | / Network Expansion / No. of stores / No. of cities / South vs West / Smaller town stores / Enhanced penetration in / Small and Emerging towns / Carried out a massive store / modernization drive / Continued investments in / volume driving large store / formats / 236 / 337 / FY16 / Current / 30 / 52 / FY16 / Current / South / West / 60% / 40% / 60% / 40% / FY16 / Current / Metros + T1 / Other / 19% / 81% / 26% / 74% / FY16 / Current / EOTF / McCafés / Drive Thrus / Delivery Stores / 0 / 138 / 75 / 274 / 59 / 68 / 124 / 292 / FY16 / Current / FY16 / Current / FY16 / Current / FY16 / Current / Rs 5.2+ bn / Invested in Network / Expansion and / Reimaging / Funded through / Internal accruals / 12

**Layout**

Four-by-two grid of small bar charts occupies the left and centre (about x 4 to 67, y 17 to 90), with a column of three checkmark bullets at the upper right (x 70.8 to 97) and a boxed call-out below them (x 70.8 to 97.2, y 54.6 to 94.6). The title 'Network Expansion' sits top-left at y 6.6 after a yellow numeral '3' and a yellow vertical bar, with a yellow 'Success drivers' tag above it; the Westlife logo is top-right and the page number '12' is bottom-right, with thin yellow rules along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Eight bar charts, each with a bold grey heading and two columns labelled FY16 and Current, no y-axis, no units, no gridlines, one thin light-grey baseline under each chart. 1) No. of stores: FY16 236 (yellow), Current 337 (red). 2) No. of cities: FY16 30 (yellow), Current 52 (red). 3) South vs West, 100% stacked: FY16 South 40% (yellow, bottom) and West 60% (red, top); Current South 40% and West 60%; legend South (yellow square) and West (red square); thin grey connector lines join the top and bottom edges of the stacks between the two columns. 4) Smaller town stores, 100% stacked: FY16 Metros + T1 81% (yellow, bottom) and Other 19% (red, top); Current Metros + T1 74% and Other 26%; legend Metros + T1 (yellow) and Other (red); a thin grey diagonal connector runs from the top of the FY16 yellow segment to the top of the Current yellow segment. 5) EOTF: FY16 0 (no bar), Current 138 (red). 6) McCafés: FY16 75 (yellow), Current 274 (red). 7) Drive Thrus: FY16 59 (yellow), Current 68 (red). 8) Delivery Stores: FY16 124 (yellow), Current 292 (red). No values are estimated; all printed values are exact. Bar colours: yellow #FFBC0D and red #DB0007 throughout. Three icons: green circles (#4CAF50 about) each containing a blue (#2196F3 about) checkmark, one beside each of the three bullets. One Westlife logo at top-right: a stylised leaf in purple, green and red above the black serif wordmark 'westlife'. A downward-pointing tan triangle (#B89A7E about) sits between 'Reimaging' and 'Funded through' inside the call-out box.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the full slide. Plain white background, flat with no gradients or shadows. Titles and the big figure are black #000000 or red #C00000; the numeral '3' and the vertical divider are yellow #FFBC0D; the 'Success drivers' tag is yellow #FFBC0D with black bold text. Body text is black #000000 and chart labels are dark grey #404040 to #595959; chart headings are bold #555555. Red accents #DB0007 and #C00000; yellow #FFBC0D; tan rules and triangle #B89A7E about. Typeface is Speedee (a geometric sans-serif), bold for titles, chart headings and emphasised figures, regular for body and labels. The slide title is about 5.9% of slide height, the big figure 'Rs 5.2+ bn' about 6.7%, body bullets about 3.2%, call-out text about 4.4%, chart labels about 2.2%. Chart headings have short tan or grey horizontal rules flanking them, partly covered by 58%-opacity white rectangles. Call-out box has a thin black (#000000) 1 pt-style border and square corners, no fill beyond white. Yellow tag has rounded corners of about 0.8% of slide height radius. No shadows.

### Slide 13

**Text**

Success drivers
4 | Cost Saving Initiatives
westhlife
Food & Paper
Distribution
Utilities & Maintenance
Employee costs
~Rs 550 mn
Cost Savings

13

**Layout**

Single-slide content area with a yellow section tag at top-left, a large section number and title row across the top beneath a thin yellow top rule, and a Westlife logo at top-right. A two-column block: a 2x2 grid of icon-and-label tiles on the left, and a tall tinted call-out panel on the right spanning roughly the lower two-thirds of the slide. Thin yellow rule along the bottom edge and page number at bottom-right, with left margin about 7 percent of width.

**Visuals**

Four line icons in a 2x2 grid on the left, all black outline pictograms on white, each sitting above a pastel label tile. Top-left icon: a takeaway food box stacked on a cardboard carton with a bag/cup shape above it (Food & Paper). Top-right icon: a megaphone held in front of a laptop, with a play button circle, a document, a Facebook 'f' square and an Instagram camera square arranged around it (Distribution). Bottom-left icon: a lightning bolt inside a circular pair of arrows, representing energy cycle (Utilities & Maintenance). Bottom-right icon: a group of three stylised people with a gear above the centre figure (Employee costs). Right side is a filled call-out panel with a thick red vertical bar on its left edge; no photographs. Icons are black, about 1.5 pt stroke, unfilled.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Title and section number in black #000000 bold sans-serif (Speedee-Bold style, grotesque), with the section number '4' and vertical divider bar in yellow #FFBC0D. Section tag is a yellow #FFBC0D rounded-end tag with black bold sans text. Body labels in regular black #000000 sans-serif. Headline figure '~Rs 550 mn' in bold red #C8161D; 'Cost Savings' in regular black sans. Top and bottom edges carry thin yellow #FFBC0D rules. Title text about 5.9 percent of slide height (capitals about 4.1 percent). Body label text about 3.7 percent. Tiles are flat rectangles with no border, no shadow, square corners. Call-out panel is flat #FFF2CF with a red #C8161D left bar about 1 percent of slide width.

### Slide 14

**Text**

Success drivers / 4 / | / Improving Profitability / FY16 / Product Mix / Net pricing / Cost Savings and / Operating Leverage / Royalty / Current / 5.9% / 1.4% / 1.8% / 3.7% / 0.0% / 12.8% / Note: Pre-IND AS Operating EBITDA Margin / 14

**Layout**

Single-column content slide with a yellow section tag at top left, a large yellow section number and vertical divider beside a bold black title on the upper left, and a full-width waterfall chart in the middle. The Westlife logo sits in the top-right corner. The italic note sits bottom left and the page number bottom right, with thin yellow bars along the top and bottom edges. Margins are about 0.7% left and 1.5% right. Content is left-aligned.

**Visuals**

One waterfall (bridge) chart, rendered as an image, with the title none and no visible y-axis or gridlines. Categories left to right: FY16, Product Mix, Net pricing, Cost Savings and Operating Leverage, Royalty, Current. Values are printed above each bar: FY16 5.9% (bold), Product Mix 1.4%, Net pricing 1.8%, Cost Savings and Operating Leverage 3.7%, Royalty 0.0%, Current 12.8% (bold). Bars: FY16 is a solid brown total bar about #957558 reaching about 5.9%. Product Mix, Net pricing and Cost Savings floating increments are yellow #FFBC0D, stepping up from the FY16 top. Royalty is a zero-height step with a grey connector line. Current is a light green total bar about #CBDB8A reaching 12.8%, the tallest bar and its value is bold. Thin light grey connector lines link each bar top to the next bar. A grey horizontal baseline runs under the bars. Category labels are grey #595959 below the baseline. The chart is not cropped, boxed or tinted and has no legend. Highlighted points are the bold 5.9% and 12.8% totals. The Westlife logo is a small leaf icon in purple, green and blue above the black serif wordmark westlife.

**Design**

### Slide 18

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: Market construct chart breaks the foodservice market into segments with growth rates, giving context for the strategy.
- Review: Weaknesses are consequential: slide 28 has no price axis labels so the ladder cannot be read, slide 18 mixes shades and tiny labels, and the animation-step duplicates (slides 38 and 39, 43, 46, 49) and the full-bleed photo runs (slides 61 to 68) add pages with no argument.
- What would change the score: I would raise the smallest chart labels and body text on slides 10 to 12, 18 and 57 to a size readable in a room, and reduce text on the densest slides to one message each.

**Text**

Indian Foodservice Market Construct and Opportunity / Informal Eating Out is INR ~3.2 tn market / Unorganised, 68% / Organised, 32% / QSR, 10% / Western Fast Food (WFF), 49% / Desserts, 17% / Chicken, 28% / Burger, 21% / Other, 34% / FSR + Cafes, 90% / Indian Fast Food (IFF), 51% / 66% of the market / IEO / Unorganised / Organised / QSR / WFF / 1% / 12% / 0% / 9% / 3% / 16% / 5% / 14% / 9% / 15% / Last 5y CAGR / Next 5y CAGR / Note: Data as of 2021, Source: Company estimates, Euromonitor / 18

**Layout**

Single white slide with a thin yellow rule along the top edge and another along the bottom edge. The title sits top-left at about 6% from the top, with the westlife logo top-right. A subtitle line sits below the title at left. The left half holds a stacked market-construct diagram from x 4% to 49%, and the right half holds a horizontal clustered bar chart from x 52% to 95% with a legend below it. A italic source note sits bottom-left at about 96.5% height and the page number sits bottom-right at about 97%.

**Visuals**

Diagram on the left: a funnel-style stacked breakdown. Top row: a grey bar labelled Unorganised, 68% (x 4 to 28%) beside a yellow bar labelled Organised, 32% (x 28 to 39%), both about 4.8% tall at y 26%. Below them, three columns linked by pale yellow #FFF2CF tapered connector shapes that widen from each column to the next. Column 1 (x 5.5 to 13.5%): a yellow #FFC000 cap labelled QSR, 10% (y 33.9 to 39.5%) over a grey #C4C4C0 block labelled FSR + Cafes, 90% (y 39.5 to 87.5%). Column 2 (x 17.9 to 25.9%): a yellow #FFC000 block labelled Western Fast Food (WFF), 49% (y 33.9 to 60.1%) over a grey #C4C4C0 block labelled Indian Fast Food (IFF), 51% (y 60 to 87.5%). Column 3 (x 30.3 to 38.3%), the Western Fast Food breakdown: Desserts, 17% in pale #FFE49E (y 33.9 to 43.3%); Chicken, 28% in ochre #C99100 (y 43.2 to 58.2%); Burger, 21% in dark brown #866100 (y 58.2 to 69.6%); Other, 34% in light gold #FFD76E (y 69.6 to 87.6%). A dashed green (#00A651 approx.) rectangle, about 2 pt stroke, surrounds the Chicken and Burger segments and extends slightly beyond them (approx. x 27.9 to 42.9%, y 32.6 to 71.4%). Beside it, a white box with a green (#00A651 approx.) border of about 2 pt contains the text 66% of the market, linked visually to the dashed rectangle. Chart on the right: a horizontal clustered bar chart with no visible numeric axis or gridlines; a thin grey vertical baseline at x about 62% runs from y 27% to 96%. Categories from top to bottom: IEO, Unorganised, Organised, QSR, WFF. Series 1 Last 5y CAGR in red #DB0007: IEO 1%, Unorganised 0%, Organised 3%, QSR 5%, WFF 9%. Series 2 Next 5y CAGR in yellow #FFBC0D: IEO 12%, Unorganised 9%, Organised 16%, QSR 14%, WFF 15%. Each value is printed at the bar end in dark grey #404040. Organised and WFF rows sit on pale #FFF2CF full-width bands. Legend at bottom centre: red square then Last 5y CAGR, yellow square then Next 5y CAGR, grey #595959 text. No photographs or icons apart from the logo.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Thin yellow #FFBC0D bars at top and bottom edges. Title in Speedee Bold, a heavy geometric sans-serif, black #000000, about 5.9% of slide height. Subtitle in Speedee Regular with the figure INR ~3.2 tn market in Speedee Bold, black #000000, about 3.3%. Diagram labels in Speedee Bold or Regular, black #000000 or white #FFFFFF on dark fills, about 2.0% to 2.2%. Chart category labels in grey #595959 and value labels in dark grey #404040, about 2.2% to 2.6%. Accent colours: yellow #FFBC0D and #FFC000, grey #C4C4C0, pale yellow #FFF2CF, red #DB0007, green dashed outline #00A651 approx. Shapes are flat with square corners and no shadows or gradients. Source note in Speedee Italic about 1.8%, black. Page number in Speedee Regular grey #7F7F7F about 1.8%.

19

**Layout**

Title sits top-left in two lines at about 3.5% from the left edge, with a westlife logo at top right. Four quadrant panels surround a central circular cycle of four arrow segments: Multi-Category top-left, Multi-Daypart top-right, Multi-Channel bottom-left, Multi Brand Extensions bottom-right. Dashed divider lines separate the left and right panels horizontally at about 62% of slide height. A red bold TAM statement is centred near the bottom, with an italic source note bottom-left and page number bottom-right. Thin yellow rules run along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Central circular cycle diagram made of four block arrows forming a loop around a red square McDonald's arch logo. Top arrow, tan #B69A81 with dark gold #C99100 shadow side, points right, carrying a line icon of a drink, fries and burger. Right arrow, yellow #FFBC0D with olive shadow, points down, carrying a clock-check icon. Bottom arrow, lime #A9C23F with teal #317A9E shadow, points left, carrying a rosette-star icon. Left arrow, blue #4C9FC8 with brown #947356 shadow, points up, carrying a box-and-hand delivery icon. Central logo: red square #DA291C with yellow arches #FFBC0D and a white border and soft drop shadow. Category photographs are cutouts on white with no boxes: double burger, nuggets and fries, wrap, fried chicken, iced coffee cups, a dessert cup with brownie, a McCafe shake with chocolate chips, and a plate of breakfast muffin with coffee, a meals tray with Coca-Cola cups, fries and burger, and a snack burger with Coke. Multi-Channel icons in red and blue line style: on-the-go figure with map pin, dine-in table with chairs, takeaway bag figure at a McDonald's kiosk, drive-thru car at window, delivery scooter with home pin. Brand logos: McCafé wordmark in dark brown #6B1E12 on a pale tan swoosh, McBreakfast yellow-orange rectangle, McDelivery yellow rounded square icon with red arches. Westlife logo at top right in black serif with a purple and green leaf mark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF.

### Slide 20

**Text**

Vision 2027

**Layout**

Single-slide title composition with no grid; the title sits in the upper-left quadrant, left-aligned at about 3.5% from the left edge and about 21% from the top. A zigzag-edged tan panel fills the slide with a white sawtooth border along the top edge. No footer, no slide number, and no other text.

**Visuals**

Two large yellow arches of a stylised M-shaped golden arch mark, cropped by the right and bottom edges of the slide, rising from the red band at the bottom. The left arch's apex sits near the horizontal centre-right at about 62% across and the right arch is cut off at the right edge. The arches are solid #FFBC0D with no outline, no shadow and no gradient. The arch mark is full-bleed to the bottom-right and overlaps the tan panel and the red band. No photograph, chart or table.

**Design**

Background is flat tan #B69A81 with a white sawtooth strip along the top edge, the teeth about 6% of slide height deep and spaced about 6.7% of slide width apart, forming a paper-bag style zigzag. Title is white #FFFFFF in a heavy geometric grotesque sans-serif bold (Speedee-Bold), approximately 14.8% of slide height, with normal letter-spacing. Accents are yellow #FFBC0D arches and a red #DB0007 band across the bottom 8.7% of the slide. No body text. Shapes are flat with hard edges, no corner radii, no shadows.

### Slide 21

**Review notes**

- Review: The deck has a clear route: a Vision 2022 scorecard on slides 6 and 7, five success drivers, market context, then Vision 2027 with a repeating four-pillar divider (slides 21, 22, 35, 51, 69) that keeps an 84-page investor deck navigable.

**Text**

Vision / 2027 / 01 / Meals Strategy / Achieve market leadership in core day parts through brand relevance / led by menu innovation and marketing / 02 / Omnichannel Strategy / Integrate various channels and touchpoints to a One McDonald’s / platform in order to provide consumers a seamless experience / 03 / Faster than ever Network Expansion / Penetrate unserved geographies and fortify existing markets with / renewed aggression / 04 / Lead with performance / Targeting superior business performance and operating efficiency / through execution excellence / 21

**Layout**

Two-zone layout: a full-height photographic panel with a curved gold overlay occupies the left 0 to about 44% of the width, and a right text column starts at about x 48.8% and runs to about x 93%. Four numbered items are stacked vertically in the right column, each with a bold heading, a two-line body paragraph and a thin divider below (dividers at about y 31.6%, 50% and 71.8%), with item 04 having no divider. Numbered circles sit on the curved edge of the panel, at x about 35 to 41%, and are staggered vertically (01 at y 12%, 02 at y 34%, 03 at y 56%, 04 at y 78%). The title 'Vision 2027' is white, left-aligned at x 2.7%, over the photo. The Westlife logo sits top right, the page number sits bottom right, and thin gold bars run along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Photograph: an interior view of a McDonald’s restaurant, showing a dessert counter with a 'DESSERTS' sign, a golden arches logo at upper left, a small 'Take Away' sign, warm ceiling lights, wooden seating and potted plants. It is shown at full height in the left panel, cropped at the right by the curved overlay, with dark-brown and black tones and warm amber highlights. Overlay: a large curved gold tint (about #B8901C to #D9A620, semi-transparent, roughly 70% opacity) covers the photo and gives it a warm yellow cast; its right edge is a convex arc with a soft grey drop shadow to the right. Numbered circles: four filled slate-blue circles (#405666), each with a thin gold rim (about #C9A227) offset to the lower right, containing the numbers 01, 02, 03 and 04 in white bold type. Logo: the Westlife logo at top right, a stylised multicoloured leaf (green, magenta and purple) above the black serif wordmark 'westlife'. Lines: four thin light-grey horizontal rules (about #D9D9D9, 1 pt) under items 01 to 03, spanning x 48.8 to 93.4%. Bars: thin gold (#F5B800) bars along the top and bottom edges.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with the photograph and gold overlay on the left side.

Thin amber rules frame the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Photograph: interior of a McDonald's restaurant, dark and blurred, showing a 'DESSERTS' sign with the golden McDonald's arches, a 'Take Away' sign, plants and a wooden bench-style seating area. It is full-height, cropped to the left panel, and covered by a semi-transparent gold-to-amber tint (about 60 to 70 percent opacity) so the image reads as dark olive-gold. Four numbered circles (01 to 04) sit on the curve's edge and on the right column, each a dark slate disc with a thin gold offset ring. ### Slide 23

**Text**

We have built menu relevance across customer occasions and day parts / Indian IEO market construct / Market leaders in snacking / Only WFF player in the segment / Snacking / Morning / Late night / Meals (Lunch+Dinner) / McFLURRY LOVE IT TO / Enhanced meals offerings: / • Gourmet burger meals: new range of indulgent, more filling burgers / • Value for money burger meals at various price points / • Chicken-led meals through the McSpicy Fried Chicken / Continued leadership in snacking: / • McDonald’s as the ultimate snacking choice / • Wide range of snacking options / • Safer and tastier options compared to roadside vendors / Graphs for representation purpose only, not to scale / 23

**Layout**

Single slide with a left-aligned two-line bold title across the top at a 3.5% left margin, and a central composite graphic (a 2x2-style mosaic of coloured panels) occupying roughly the left-centre of the slide with a two-part text column on the right. The graphic is captioned 'Indian IEO market construct' above it. A small italic footnote sits bottom-left, the page number bottom-right, and the westlife logo sits top-right; thin yellow bars run along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Composite diagram titled 'Indian IEO market construct' made of four panels. Top-left panel: solid red #DB0007 labelled 'Snacking' with a gold #1 medal icon and the italic label 'Market leaders in snacking'; it contains a crispy chicken sandwich in a bun with lettuce and tomato on white paper beside a red fries carton with yellow M logo (left), and a group of four cafe mugs (brown with latte foam, green, navy and dark brown) on a dark chocolate slab with coffee beans (right). Bottom-left panel: solid tan #B39A80 labelled 'Morning' with an orange-yellow 'EXCLUSIVE' rosette badge and the italic label 'Only WFF player in the segment'; it shows an egg and cheese muffin sandwich, a golden hash brown patty and a brown McCafe cup with white McCafe logo on white paper. Bottom-right narrow panel: solid green #00B050 labelled 'Late night' with a gold #1 medal icon; it shows a beige iced frappe with whipped cream and straw, a chicken burger with green lettuce, and a red fries carton. Large right panel: solid yellow #FFBC0D labelled 'Meals (Lunch+Dinner)' containing a gourmet double-patty burger with sesame bun, cheese and lettuce, a red fries carton and a cola cup with straw; below it a meal of two cola cups, fried chicken drumsticks and wings in a red carton and popcorn-style nuggets in a cardboard tray; and a blue paper McFlurry cup with a McDonald's arch logo and Oreo cookie pieces. A small red circle sits partly behind the burger. Gold and red orthogonal connector lines link the text column to the burger photo and to the snacking mugs. Photos are not cropped, sit on white or cream paper wraps, and are lit evenly from the front with soft shadows. Medal icons: a gold #1 medal with red, white and blue ribbon at top-left of the Snacking panel and a second identical medal at the top of the Late night panel. Footnote text is not a visual.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF background. Clean white background with thin yellow #FFBC0D bars across the top and bottom edges. Title is black #000000 in Speedee-Bold, a heavy geometric sans-serif, about 5.9% of slide height, not italic. Section heading 'Enhanced meals offerings:' is gold #C99100 in Speedee-Bold, about 3.0% of slide height, centred. Heading 'Continued leadership in snacking:' is red #C00000 in Speedee-Bold, about 3.0%, centred. Body bullets are black #000000 in Speedee-Regular with bold key phrases in Speedee-Bold, about 2.4% of slide height. Panel labels inside the graphic are white #FFFFFF in Speedee-BoldItalic, about 2.2 to 2.6%, except the yellow panel label which is black. Footnote is grey #8A8A8D in Speedee-Italic, about 1.7%. Page number is grey #7F7F7F Speedee-Regular, about 1.8%. Connector lines are gold #FFC000 and red #DB0007, about 0.3% stroke, with square diamond and round dot end markers; no shadows, gradients or rounded corners on panels.

**Text**

Burgers | We have built burger leadership through burger / offerings for all occasions / Burgers / westlife / Classic burgers / Indulgent burgers / Burger meals / Core, iconic burgers that are / bestsellers on the menu and have / become staples for burger lovers in the / country / A new range of premium, indulgent, / and more filling burgers which are / suited to the flavor trends in the / market / Bundles and add-ons to help choose / from a host of pocket-friendly and / delicious combos, and create / wholesome burger meals / 27

**Layout**

Three equal columns of rounded cards sit below a two-line title that starts at the left margin at about 3.5% and runs across the top, with the Burgers oval logo and westlife wordmark in the top-right corner. Each card has a yellow pill heading centred at the top, a photograph in the middle and a centred caption at the bottom; a thin yellow bar runs along the top and bottom edges and the page number sits at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Three photographs of McDonald's style food on white backgrounds, all with no boxing or frames beyond the card outlines. Column 1 (Classic burgers): two burgers on a yellow-striped white paper sheet; the back burger has a sesame bun top, a crispy orange-brown patty with red-orange sauce and sliced red onion; the front burger has a sesame bun, a white sauce layer, shredded green lettuce and a golden crispy chicken patty on a plain bottom bun, lit from above, with warm orange-brown tones. Column 2 (Indulgent burgers): two stacked burgers on a yellow-striped paper; the back burger has a sesame bun, a crispy patty with melted white cheese sauce visible at the bottom, green lettuce and sliced green jalapenos; the front burger has a plain bun, a crispy chicken patty, orange cheese slice, sliced green jalapenos, lettuce, white sauce and an orange sauce on the bottom bun. Column 3 (Burger meals): a meal composition with a McCafe iced coffee in a brown cup with whipped cream topping at the top left, a McCafe brown iced drink in a dark cup, a Coca-Cola glass with ice at the top, a red carton of golden fries at the right, a chicken burger and a second burger in the centre, golden nuggets with a sauce cup and a blue McFlurry cup with black cookie pieces at the bottom right, with scattered coffee beans at the lower left; lighting is soft and even from the front, with dominant colours of golden brown, red, white and blue. Overlays: none. Icons: none. Logo: Burgers oval with a black filled ellipse, white bold Burgers text, red inner ring and yellow outer ring; westlife wordmark in dark serif lettering with a purple and green leaf above the letter i.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF with a thin yellow top bar and bottom bar in yellow #FFBC0D. Title in Speedee Bold, black #000000 for the main phrase, with Burgers | in Speedee Regular red #C00000; title size about 5.2% of slide height. Pill headings in Speedee Bold black #000000 on yellow #FFBC0D, size about 3.3%. Body captions in Speedee Regular black #000000 with bold runs, size about 3.0%. Card outlines are thin black #000000 rounded rectangles with generous corner radii of about 3.5% of slide height. Page number in grey #7F7F7F at about 1.8%. No shadows or gradients.

### Slide 28

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: Burger pricing ladder arranges products by price tier so the acquisition and retention logic is visible.
- Review: Weaknesses are consequential: slide 28 has no price axis labels so the ladder cannot be read, slide 18 mixes shades and tiny labels, and the animation-step duplicates (slides 38 and 39, 43, 46, 49) and the full-bleed photo runs (slides 61 to 68) add pages with no argument.
- Suggested repair: Remove the build-step duplicates on slides 38, 39, 43, 46 and 49, add price values or a labelled axis to the ladder on slide 28, and caption or trim the unlabelled store photo run so each image carries a point.

**Layout**

Three horizontal tier bands (Top tier, Mid tier, Entry level) stacked down the slide, each with a vertical label box at the left edge, above a full-width price axis bar of seven equal grey cells labelled 'Price >>' along the bottom. The title sits top-left in two lines spanning most of the width, with a circular Burgers logo and the westlife logo at top right; the slide number 28 sits bottom right on the margin.

**Visuals**

Diagram-style pricing ladder with 40+ food photographs of burgers, wraps, fries and drinks, each with a bold black caption beneath. Photos sit on a cream/yellow band per tier, rising in the top tier and stepping left to right by price. Top tier: McCheese Veg | Chicken pair (top centre); Gourmet Meal – Indulgent Meal (top right, boxed meal with two burgers, fries and Coca-Cola cups); Maharaja Mac Veg | Maharaja Mac Chicken (centre); McSpicy Premium Veg | Chicken (centre right). Mid tier: Corn & Cheese | Chicken & Cheese (centre); McVeggie | McChicken (lower centre); Filet-O-Fish (centre); McSpicy Paneer | McSpicy Chicken (centre); McVeggie | McChicken Meal (centre right, with Coca-Cola and fries); McSpicy Paneer | McSpicy Chicken Meal (right); Corn & Cheese | Chicken & Cheese Meal (right, with Coca-Cola and fries); Filet-O-Fish Meal (right, with Coca-Cola and fries). Entry level: McAloo Tikki | Mexican McAloo (left pair of burgers); Chicken Kebab (single burger, left); McAloo Tikki | Mexican McAloo Meal (centre, with fries and Coca-Cola); Chicken Kebab Meal (centre right, with fries and Coca-Cola). Photos are product shots on white backgrounds, with soft shadows, bright even studio lighting, warm orange-brown bun and red and green tones, and no cropping, full-bleed or boxing. No logos or icons other than the Burgers and westlife logos.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background (#FFFFFF). Tier bands use tinted fills: top tier band #FFBC0D at 21% opacity (pale yellow, about #FFF2CC), mid tier band #C99100 at 21% opacity (pale beige, about #F3E9CC), entry level band #866100 at 21% opacity (about #E6DCC6). Tier label boxes: Top tier #FFD76E, Mid tier #FFBC0D, Entry level #C99100. Title text black #000000 in Speedee-Bold, with 'Burgers |' in Speedee-Regular red #C00000. Thin yellow rules (#FFBC0D) run along the top and bottom edges. Flat shapes with square corners, no shadows or gradients. Slide number Speedee-Regular #7F7F7F.

**Layout**

Title sits top-left in two lines spanning about 3.5% to 78% of the width, with a logo pair in the top-right corner (about 83% to 99% of width). A two-column layout: map on the left (about 8% to 49% of width, 17.7% to 92% of height) and a text bullet list plus bar chart on the right (about 56% to 94% width). Source line bottom-left at about 96% height and page number bottom-right at about 97% height. Left margin about 3.5%.

**Visuals**

Choropleth-style map of India titled 'What percentage of population eats Meat?' with a legend bar from 30% to 100% in red shades (30%, 44%, 58%, 72%, 86%, 100%). Each state is labelled with its percentage; state values are: LA 87%, JK 88%, HP 57%, PB 45%, UK 75%, HR 32%, DL 68%, RJ 31%, UP 60%, BR 89%, SK 91%, AR 99.7%, AS 99.5%, NL 99.8%, ML 99.5%, MN 99.7%, MZ 99.8%, TR 99.6%, WB 99.2%, JH 95%, OD 96%, CG 86%, MP 51%, GJ 45%, DH 81%, MH 77%, GA 96%, KA 81%, TS 96%, AP 96%, TN 96%, KL 99%, PY 98%, AN 99.5%, LD 100.0%. Left of the map is a vertical stacked red-to-cream bar list of 36 region labels with values (see text). Key callouts: 77% of population eats chicken, fish and other meat; 83% men; 71% women; 74% in 2015-16; 77% in 2019-21. Map has a small red square icon at bottom-right of the map area. Bar chart titled 'Average Daily Sales' with no axis, no value axis labels, no legend and no gridlines. Three columns with labelled values: FY16 1.x (yellow #FFBC0D, about 1x height), West (Current) 1.5x (yellow #FFBC0D), South (Current) 1.8x (red #DB0007, tallest). A thin tan (#B69A81) curved connector arrow runs from above FY16 across horizontally to above South (Current) with an arrowhead pointing right, indicating growth from 1.x to 1.8x. Baseline is a light grey horizontal line under the bars. Photograph or illustration: none beyond the map.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Thin yellow (#FFBC0D) bars along the top and bottom edges of the slide. Title: first run 'Chicken |' in red (#C00000) regular Speedee sans-serif, remainder in black (#000000) bold Speedee sans-serif; title text about 5.2% of slide height per line. Body bullets in black Speedee regular, about 3.3% of slide height, with bold lines for the last bullet. Chart title in grey bold (#595959) about 3.1%; chart labels in dark grey (#404040) and axis labels grey (#595959) about 2.6%. Source line black about 1.7%. Page number grey (#7F7F7F) about 1.8%. Bullets are Wingdings square (▪). Logo: yellow-outlined ellipse with black and red fill and white 'Chicken' word, plus 'westlife' wordmark with a green and purple leaf. No shadows or gradients.

**Visuals**

Photographs of fast-food items on white or cream wrapper paper, cut out with no background, arranged in tiers. Left tier area: McSpicy Chicken Premium burger (top, lettuce, cheese, sauce, sesame bun), McCheese Chicken burger (top, sesame bun, lettuce, sauce), Chicken Maharaja Mac (top, stacked patties, cheese, lettuce, tomato, sesame bun), Big Spicy Chicken Wrap (mid, wrapped sandwich in a wrapper, tomato and lettuce visible, cut diagonally), McSpicy Chicken (mid, crispy fillet burger with lettuce and white sauce), McChicken (mid, patty with shredded lettuce and white sauce on bun), Chicken & Cheese (mid, burger with cheese, sliced pickles and onion), Chicken Kebab (entry, burger with red onion and sauce on wrapper). Bone-in column: McSpicy Fried Chicken bucket (fried pieces in a cardboard bucket on a tray, orange-brown) and McSpicy Fried Chicken wings (two fried wings on wrapper). Lighting is even studio light, dominant colours are golden brown and orange with white backgrounds. Images are full-colour, not cropped, with no overlay. Logos: a red and black oval Chicken logo with a yellow outline, and the westlife logo (serif wordmark with a purple and green leaf mark).

Column headings and item labels are Speedee bold black #000000 at about 2.6 percent. Slide number is regular grey #7F7F7F at about 1.8 percent. Accents are thin black rules and vertical dividers, a grey #7F7F7F frame, and yellow #FFC000 bars at top and bottom. No shadows or gradients; the frame has square corners.

**Layout**

Four-column-plus-one arrangement on a white slide: a bold two-line title spans the top left with a Chicken badge and the Westlife logo at top right. Country panels sit in a grid of dashed-outline rounded boxes: Taiwan, UK and Japan in the left column, Hong Kong and Indonesia in the second column, USA, Malaysia and Italy in the third column, and Singapore as a tall panel on the far right. Each country name sits in a yellow pill tab on the top edge of its box. A thin yellow rule runs along the top and bottom edges, and the page number 31 sits bottom right, outside the Singapore panel.

**Visuals**

Twenty-three product photographs of McDonald’s chicken items, each on a white background with no crop or tint, arranged within the dashed country panels. Taiwan: BLT Spicy Crispy Chicken Leg Burger (burger with lettuce, tomato, bacon, red sauce, bun); Original Wheat Crispy Chicken Wings (golden fried wings, cluster); Spicy Crispy Chicken Drumsticks (two fried drumsticks, one with a bite out); Spicy Crispy Chicken Wings (fried wing pieces). UK: Chicken Selects (three breaded strips with a dip pot of white sauce to the right). Japan: Shaka-Chicki (fried chicken piece in a white paper box with orange logo), Chicken Crisp Muffin (crisp chicken patty in a muffin bun), Gohan Chicken (chicken patty burger with cheese, lettuce, bun). Hong Kong: Grilled Chicken Twisty Pasta (bowl of pasta, corn and grilled chicken pieces), Honey BBQ Crispy Thighs (fries, Coca-Cola cup and fried thigh and drumstick with Chinese label). USA: Deluxe Crispy Chicken Sandwich (burger with lettuce, tomato, golden bun). Malaysia: GCB Grilled Chicken Burger (bun, lettuce, grilled patty, dark sauce), Ayam Goreng McD (dark fried chicken pieces). Italy: Salad with Crispy Chicken Breast (salad bowl in a green-camouflage box). Indonesia: Spicy Chicken Fingers (three fries-shaped pieces in red fries carton), Spicy Chicken Bites (nuggets in branded paper sleeve), PaNas 2 Ayam Kimchi (fried chicken, rice and kimchi on a plate, cup of drink, yellow BARU badge). Singapore: Grilled Chicken Salad (bowl of greens, tomato, grilled chicken slices), Buttermilk Crispy Chicken (burger with buttermilk fried patty and cheese), Breakfast Wrap Chicken Sausage (wrap in blue sleeve, chicken sausage). Logos: Chicken badge (black and red ellipse with yellow outer ring and white Chicken text) top right; Westlife logo (purple-green leaf with black serif wordmark) top right corner. Lighting is flat, even studio lighting; the dominant colours are golden fried browns, greens and white, with yellow and red accents.

**Design**

**Layout**

Title block spans the top with a red 'Coffee |' section label and bold black headline in two lines, left-aligned at about 3.5% from the left edge; the Coffee and Westlife logos sit in the top-right corner. The body is two columns: left text column (statement and two bullets) and right column with a stacked bar chart above a grey callout box with a downward pointer. A full-width yellow-tinted banner sits near the bottom, with a source line bottom-left and page number bottom-right, framed by thin yellow rules at the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Stacked column chart (two columns, no axis titles, no gridlines, no y-axis shown). Categories on horizontal axis: World, India. Series: Retail Coffee (yellow #FFBC0D, bottom segment) and Coffee + Tea Foodservice (red #DB0007, top segment). Labelled values: World Retail Coffee 54%, World Coffee + Tea Foodservice 46%; India Retail Coffee 77%, India Coffee + Tea Foodservice 23%. Legend across the top of the chart: yellow square 'Retail Coffee', red square 'Coffee + Tea Foodservice'. Baseline is a thin light grey horizontal line. A thin olive-green (#9BBB59-like) rectangle outlines the India column's red 23% segment and the top of the India bar, with a short olive connector line to the callout 'Strong Double Digit Next 5y CAGR' at right. Bar segments are flat with no shadows. Grey callout box (#F2F2F2) with a downward triangular pointer toward the banner, containing centered text. Coffee logo: concentric ellipses yellow #FFBC0D outer, red #C00000 middle, black inner ellipse with white 'Coffee' text. Westlife logo: black serif wordmark 'westlife' with a multicolour leaf mark (purple, green, red) above the final letters.

### Slide 33

**Text**

Coffee | Our objective is to become category leaders in the / Coffee market in our region by inducting new consumers / Coffee / McCafe Stores / 100% / ~600 / 81% / 32% / 75 / 274 / FY16 / Current / Target / 100% / McCafe / Penetration / Drive awareness / for great tasting / coffee by McCafé / Build credibility / for quality / McCafé Coffee / Build habit by / increasing / frequency of / consumption / Deliver quality / coffee at great / prices / McCafe Contribution / 9% / 12% / 15-18% / FY16 / Current / Target / 15-18% / McCafe / Contribution / Note: % of sales for Stores with McCafe / 33

**Layout**

Four equal outlined boxes sit in a 2x2 grid on the left half, with a stacked column of two bar charts and two stat boxes on the right half. The title runs across the top in two left-aligned lines starting near the left margin, with the logos at top right. A note sits bottom-left of the right column and the slide number sits bottom-right, with thin yellow bars along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Four icons on yellow circles: top-left a black outline megaphone on a #FFBC0D circle; top-middle a black outline thumbs-up with sparkles on a #FFBC0D circle; bottom-left a black outline rising bar-chart with an up arrow on a #FFBC0D circle; bottom-right a black outline steaming coffee cup on a saucer on a #FFBC0D circle. Chart 1 titled McCafe Stores, a vertical bar chart with three categories FY16, Current, Target on a light grey baseline, no visible axes or numeric scale. Series values: FY16 bar 75 (yellow #FFBC0D), Current bar 274 (yellow), Target bar red #DB0007 with 100% label; callouts above bars read 32%, 81% and 100% in rounded tan-outlined boxes, and small text ~600 sits above the Target bar area. Chart 2 titled McCafe Contribution, a vertical bar chart on a grey baseline with categories FY16, Current, Target. Values: FY16 bar yellow with label 9%; Current bar yellow with label 12%; Target bar red #DB0007 with a light grey label box reading 15-18% in bold black. A thin yellow diagonal arrow with a pointed head runs up and to the right above the Current bar toward the Target bar. Logo: Coffee roundel of a yellow outer ellipse, red middle ellipse and black inner ellipse with white bold Coffee text; westlife wordmark in black serif with a purple and green leaf above the final letters.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a thin yellow #FFBC0D bar along top and bottom edges. Title Coffee | in regular red #C00000 and the rest in bold black #000000, typeface Speedee (geometric humanist sans-serif, Bold and Regular weights), title size about 5.2 percent of slide height. Body text in black #000000 Speedee Regular about 4.4 percent of slide height, with bold keywords. Stat numbers 100% and 15-18% in bold red #C8161D at about 6.7 percent. Feature boxes have thin yellow #FFBC0D outlines with square corners and no shadow. Bars are flat with no gradients, yellow #FFBC0D and red #DB0007. Chart labels are black Speedee Regular about 2.2 percent.

**Layout**

Three-column card grid under a two-line left-aligned title at top left, with a Westlife logo and a yellow-and-red Coffee badge at top right. Column 1 (COFFEE) and column 2 (INDULGENCE) run full height at the left and centre; column 3 (TEA) sits on the right with Sweet treats set lower on the right, creating an L-shaped stepped panel. Page number 34 sits bottom right in grey; a thin yellow rule runs along the top and bottom edges. Margins are about 3% left and right.

**Visuals**

Product photographs and cut-out images, no charts. Hot coffee group: several brown McCafé ceramic mugs with latte art, a brown-and-orange paper cup labelled ROAST COFFEE, and a few coffee beans, on a warm beige background. Frappes and Shakes group: three to four plastic-style glasses with whipped cream, chocolate drizzle and a pink strawberry shake, in shades of brown, pink and cream. Smoothies: a yellow mango smoothie and a pink-purple berry smoothie in tall cups with red cushion-style lids. Cooler: a yellow sweet lime cooler and a red berry cooler in glass mugs with handles. Hot tea: a brown McCafé mug with a light tea and a brown mug with green matcha-style tea. Iced tea: three tall clear cups with orange lemon, brown and orange-red drinks, with red lids. Cold coffee: two iced glasses, one brown iced coffee and one whipped cream iced americano with a handle, plus a red-brown iced tea cup. Sweet treats: a blueberry muffin, chocochip muffin, a slice of blueberry cheesecake and a slice of chocolate cake with a cinnamon stick, all on paper cases. Westlife logo: a purple-green leaf above the lowercase word westlife in dark grey serif. Coffee badge: a red-yellow-black oval with the word Coffee in white bold.

**Design**

Background: White #FFFFFF with beige photographic panels behind the columns. White slide background. Beige photographic panels behind the three columns with a warm tan tint. Title in Speedee Bold black with the word Coffee and the vertical bar in red #C00000. Section headers in white bold capitals on #C00000 pills. Sub-card titles in black bold on #FFBC0D yellow pills. Card bodies are pale yellow #FFE49E rounded rectangles with black outlines about 0.3 percent of slide height. Body text in Speedee Regular black with yellow #FFBC0D bullet dots. Title about 5.6 percent of slide height; body about 2.6 percent. Large corner radii on the column panels and pills, a small radius on cards. Thin yellow #FFBC0D rule at top and bottom edges.

### Slide 35

**Review notes**

- Review: The deck has a clear route: a Vision 2022 scorecard on slides 6 and 7, five success drivers, market context, then Vision 2027 with a repeating four-pillar divider (slides 21, 22, 35, 51, 69) that keeps an 84-page investor deck navigable.

**Text**

Vision
2027
01
Meals Strategy
Achieve market leadership in core day parts through brand relevance
led by menu innovation and marketing
02
Omnichannel Strategy
Integrate various channels and touchpoints to a One McDonald’s
platform in order to provide consumers a seamless experience
03
Faster than ever Network Expansion
Penetrate unserved geographies and fortify existing markets with
renewed aggression
04
Lead with performance
Targeting superior business performance and operating efficiency
through execution excellence
35

**Layout**

Two-zone layout: a full-height photographic panel occupies the left 44% of the slide with its right edge cut by a large convex gold arc, and a four-item numbered list sits in the right column starting at about x 48.8%. The title Vision 2027 is stacked on two lines at left over the photo, left-aligned at about x 2.7%. Four numbered circles sit on the arc edge at x about 35 to 41%, one per item, spaced evenly down the slide. Items are separated by thin grey rules at about y 28%, 50% and 72%, with the second item highlighted in a right-pointing chevron band. The westlife logo sits at top right, a thin gold bar runs along the top and bottom edges, and the page number 35 sits at bottom right with a margin of about 1.5% from the right edge.

**Visuals**

Photograph of a McDonald's restaurant interior, a dessert counter and seating area with golden arches signage, the DESSERTS sign, a Take Away sign, plants, a wooden bench and dim warm ambient lighting, framed full height and cropped on its right side by the gold arc. A gold tint overlay in yellow-brown covers the photo, darkest at the upper left and lighter toward the arc. Dominant colours are dark brown, olive green and golden yellow. Other visuals: four dark slate circles with gold crescent offsets carrying the numerals 01 to 04, a pale yellow chevron band behind item 02, thin light grey horizontal rules between items, and the westlife logo (purple and green leaf mark above the wordmark) at top right.

**Design**

Background is white with a full-height photo and gold arc overlay on the left. Titles and item headings are black #000000 bold geometric sans-serif (Speedee-Bold, close to Poppins Bold) at about 3.7% of slide height, with body text in black #000000 regular Speedee-Regular at about 2.6% of slide height. Hero title Vision 2027 is white #FFFFFF bold at about 13.3% of slide height. Number circles are slate #405666 with gold #C9A227 offset crescents and white bold numerals at about 6.7% of slide height. Accent colours are gold #F7B500 for the top and bottom bars and pale yellow #FFE49E for the highlight band. Shapes have square corners, no visible shadow on the rules, and the circles have a soft drop shadow. Page number is grey #7F7F7F regular.

**Layout**

Single slide with a bold left-aligned title across the top-left (about 1.3% from the left edge, top at about 3.4%). A westlife logo sits at the top-right corner, and thin yellow rules run along the top and bottom edges. A central hub diagram occupies the middle of the slide: eight channel buttons form a ring around a red and yellow McDonald's roundel, with the 'Touchpoints' label and up/down chevrons at the left and the 'Channels' label and chevrons at the right. The page number 36 sits bottom-right at about 98% x and 97% y.

**Visuals**

Diagram: a hub-and-ring diagram inside a rounded light-grey panel. Centre: a red circle (#DA0000 approx) with a yellow McDonald's arches logo, set inside a white ring and a gold outer ring (#FFBC0D). Eight rounded-rectangle buttons surround it, with tan (#B09478 approx) buttons for Dine In (top), Take Away (top-right), Drive Thru (right), Delivery (bottom-right) and On The Go (bottom), and gold (#C99100 approx) buttons for Self Ordering Kiosk (top-left), McDelivery (Own App + 3PO) (left) and McDonald's Omni Channel App (bottom-left). Each button has a white border and a soft drop shadow. Double-headed pale yellow (#FFE699 approx) arrows connect each button to the centre and to its neighbours. Icons: a dark-circle illustration of a table with two red chairs and a 'social distancing maintained' sign above Dine In; a red 'COLLECT HERE' awning with a masked staff member holding a McDonald's bag beside Take Away; a dark-circle illustration of a yellow car at a red drive-thru window beside Drive Thru; a dark-circle illustration of a red scooter rider with a McDonald's bag and a yellow home-pin beside Delivery; a dark-circle illustration of a walking customer with a McDonald's bag, a yellow pin and a red road beneath On The Go; a self-ordering kiosk screen (white with red and yellow menu lines) at the top-left; a red McDelivery app icon with a yellow arches logo and the word McDelivery at the left; a yellow McDonald's arches logo standing alone at the bottom-left; and grey double chevrons (#BFBFBF approx) pointing up and down beside both labels. Lighting is flat; the illustrations are full colour, not cropped, and sit in their own circular or boxed frames.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title is heavy geometric sans-serif (Speedee-Bold style, close to Helvetica Black) in black #000000, large, with normal case. Button labels are white bold sans-serif (Speedee-Bold) on tan or gold fills. Touchpoints label is gold #C99100 and Channels label is tan #B69A81, both bold sans-serif at about 4.4% of slide height. Title is about 5.9% of slide height; button labels are about 2.0 to 2.2% of slide height. Page number is regular sans-serif in grey #7F7F7F. Accent colours are McDonald's yellow #FCB715 for the thin top and bottom rules and the gold hub, red #DA0000 for the centre. Shapes are rounded rectangles with white outlines and soft drop shadows; the panel behind the diagram is rounded with a faint shadow.

### Slide 37

**Text**

..now transforming into a digitally integrated brand to / enable a seamless customer experience across touchpoints / westlife / MULTI TOUCHPOINTS / UNIFIED EXPERIENCE / Blurring the lines between / channels to provide a / seamless experience / Coherence across / channels / Higher efficiencies / Integrated offers / Rich data on customer / behaviors / Brand forward experience / & / Customer Loyalty / 37

**Layout**

Two-zone slide with the title in two left-aligned lines across the top (starting at about x 3.5%, y 3%), a Westlife logo at the top right corner, and a three-icon group on the left set against a dotted dashed-border 'Unified experience' panel on the right. A centre caption and a pale arrow sit between them. Bottom row has four check-marked bullets in two columns on the left, a grey double chevron, and a right-aligned two-colour closing statement. Page number 37 sits at the bottom right corner, with a thin yellow rule along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Left group: three pairs of stylised line-art people (a man with short hair and a woman with long hair, black outlines, white fill) at the top of three columns, separated by two vertical red dashed lines. Each pair has a vertical double-headed yellow (#FFC000) arrow linking it to an icon below. Below the arrows: a seated person at a desk with a row of three dots above the head, a standing person beside a large tablet/kiosk on a stand, and a hand tapping a phone screen showing a checkmark icon. Icons are black line art on white with grey desk and floor lines. Centre: a pale cream (#EEF3D9) right-pointing block arrow with black outline and white-free interior, sitting under the caption. Right panel: a yellow dashed-border rectangle (#FFC000 dashes, about 2pt) with a fine yellow dot pattern fill and the label UNIFIED EXPERIENCE above; inside are the same couple pair at top centre, a yellow gradient triangle (apex upward, fading to transparent) below them, and the same three icons (seated person, standing person with tablet, phone with hand tap) along the bottom. Bottom left: four green (#4CAF50) circles with white-on-blue (#2196F3) check ticks. Bottom centre-right: a grey (#A6A6A6) double chevron pointing right. No photographs.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF.

The right column holds a bar chart headed by a rule-split title, with a boxed 100% callout and its footnote at the lower right. A dashed vertical divider at x 50 separates the columns. Series values with printed data labels: FY16 shown as a dash (zero), FY17 1, FY18 9, FY19 25, FY20 66, FY21 75, FY22 121, Current 138. No y-axis or units printed; bar heights are proportional to these values. Bars are solid #FFBC0D with no outline, width about 2 percent of slide width, spaced evenly. Picture grid: six captioned panels in two rows of three. Row 1: Table Service (photo of diners seated at a booth with a server in a black uniform and a black apron, warm interior, wood shelving behind, full-colour, boxed); Kiosk Ordering (photo of two men at a touchscreen kiosk, one bald man in the foreground, a green ORDER HERE sign, dark background, boxed); Split Counter (photo of an interior with a long counter, digital menu screens, and red pendant lamps, boxed). Callout: rectangle outline in yellow.

Background white #FFFFFF. Thin full-width yellow bars at top and bottom edges in #FFC000. Panel captions are white boxes with thin grey #7F7F7F border and text in Speedee Regular #000000. Tan rules #B8967A, 2 px. Yellow callout border #FFC000 about 0.2 percent of slide width.
