### Slide 41

**Text**

Before / Jayanagar Bangalore / After / 41 / westlife / DELICIOUS BURGER / ORDER HERE / ORDER HERE / Cool down With Your Summer Favourites / KIOSK CAFE

**Layout**

Split composition: a small 'Before' photo sits boxed in the top-left corner (0% to 38.4% width, 0% to 51.3% height) and a larger 'After' photo bleeds off the right and bottom edges, starting at 33.5% x and 21.2% y. The title 'Jayanagar Bangalore' is right-aligned in the white upper-right area, ending at about 96.5% x, with its baseline near 17.4% y. The westlife logo is top-right at 91.4% x, 0% y. The 'Before' and 'After' tags are yellow labels at the top-left of the Before photo and the left of the After photo's upper-right region. The slide number sits bottom-right at 98.4% x, 97% y. Thin yellow rules run along the top edge and along the bottom-left edge.

**Visuals**

Two photographs. (1) Before photo, top-left, boxed, not full-bleed, 562 by 422 pixels: interior of a fast-food dining room under a glossy red ceiling with recessed downlights and a pendant lamp; a red wall with large white diagonal graphic shapes; wooden-look chairs and grey-topped tables in rows; daylight through windows at the back; three women seated at a table in the foreground, one in a green scarf, with a blue bag on the floor; a grey and white counter edge at lower left. Lighting is mixed artificial and daylight; dominant colours red, white and wood brown. (2) After photo, bottom-right, bleeds to the right and bottom slide edges, 1951 by 1301 pixels: interior of a redesigned restaurant with a dark grey acoustic-tile ceiling and recessed square downlights; a white subway-tile wall on the left carrying large black three-dimensional letters reading DELICIOUS BURGER (partly cropped at the right end of the wall); a wood-look herringbone floor; a light wood ceiling soffit; a row of white tables with black-and-white zigzag upholstered stools along the wall; free-standing black self-order kiosks with dark green screens and yellow ORDER HERE header signs; black bar stools; yellow floor markings; a dark counter with a KIOSK CAFE vertical sign at the back. Lighting is warm, bright and even; dominant colours are white, charcoal grey, warm wood and yellow. A yellow tag overlays its upper-right corner.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white layout with yellow accents and black bold headline. Title and tag text use a heavy geometric sans-serif (Speedee Bold) in black #000000 and white #FFFFFF. Title is large, roughly 5.9% of slide height. Tag text is about 2.6% of slide height. Accent yellow #FFBC0D at 81% opacity for the tags and thin rules. Slide number is Speedee Regular in grey #7F7F7F at about 1.8% of slide height. No corner radii, shadows or gradients; rectangular tags and images with square corners.

### Slide 42

**Text**

Before / Hinjewadi Pune / After / 42

**Layout**

Two-part composition: a large photo pair on the right-lower and left-top with a white field; the title 'Hinjewadi Pune' is right-aligned in the upper right white area, below the Westlife logo at top right. A thin yellow rule runs along the top edge and along the bottom-left edge of the white area. The slide number sits bottom right in grey. Margins are small (about 1-4% of slide width).

**Visuals**

Two photographs. (1) Top-left 'Before' photo, a fast-food restaurant interior viewed from the dining side toward the counter: a dark wooden-look ceiling with recessed round downlights, a striped brown pillar at left, yellow-and-black ORDER / COLLECT signage above the counter, a row of backlit red-and-white menu panels, a man in a striped shirt and jeans facing the counter, a staff member in a blue shirt with a cap and mask, a seated customer in a striped top at bottom left, and yellow floor-marking squares on grey tiles. Warm, slightly low lighting; cropped at the slide edge, boxed as a rectangle with no border. (2) Bottom-right 'After' photo, the same restaurant refitted: a perforated wood-finish ceiling with track spotlights, a bright yellow angled feature wall at left, grey concrete-look long communal tables with black-and-red tall stools with red legs, round yellow-and-black no-entry style floor stickers on the tables and floor, a menu board panel with white sheets in a pink frame, digital menu screens, and a order counter with the word ORDER at right. Bright, warm-neutral lighting with yellow and grey dominant. The photo is bled off the right and bottom edges, with a thin yellow outline along its top and left edges. A perforated-metal patterned panel with dots appears at the far right edge. Overlay: a yellow label box reading 'After' sits over the top-right of this photo.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title in bold black sans-serif (Speedee-Bold family style, closest a bold geometric grotesque), large. Labels 'Before' and 'After' are white bold sans-serif on solid yellow tabs. Yellow accent #FFBC0D with 81% opacity. Thin yellow rule along top edge and bottom edge (#FFBC0D). Slide number in regular grey sans-serif. Westlife logo: purple-and-green leaf mark above black serif wordmark 'westlife' in the top right.

**Layout**

Single slide with a title band across the top, a left column (heading, bullets, grey checklist box, Swiggy and Zomato logos) and a right column (McDelivery icon, heading, bullets, grey checklist box). A circular ring diagram with a scooter illustration sits in the centre. Thin yellow bars run along the top and bottom edges. The title is left-aligned at about 3.5% from the left edge, the Westlife logo sits in the top-right corner, and the page number is bottom-right at about 1.8% of slide height.

**Visuals**

1) Circular cycle diagram in the centre (about x 28-74%, y 17-84%): two thick arc segments, one yellow #FFBC0D and one tan #B69A81, each with a triangular arrowhead, forming a clockwise-style loop; the yellow arc runs from top-right arrowhead down the left side to bottom-centre, the tan arc runs from upper-right down the right side to the bottom-centre arrowhead. Both arcs have a darker shaded gradient near the top-centre and bottom-centre joins. A thin outer circle line in yellow (upper-left) and tan (lower-right) with small dot endpoints surrounds them. 2) Illustration centred in the ring (about x 38-59%, y 37-68%): a delivery rider in a black helmet on a black scooter with orange-rimmed wheels, wearing an orange top and blue trousers, carrying a cardboard bag with fries, a red cup with straw and a burger; flat vector style, side view facing right, soft grey ground shadow beneath, full figure, no cropping. 3) Swiggy logo bottom-left (about x 3-12%, y 79-95%): orange map-pin icon with a stylised S and the wordmark SWIGGY in spaced orange capitals. 4) Zomato wordmark (about x 12-28%, y 81-87%): black bold italic lowercase 'zomato' on white. 5) Westlife logo top-right: purple and green leaf mark above black serif wordmark 'westlife'. 6) McDelivery app icon (about x 79-86%, y 15-27%): yellow rounded-square tile with red circle containing yellow McDonald's arches and small dots, and the word McDelivery in black bold below. 7) Two grey rounded rectangles (checklist panels) with green circular check badges having blue ticks: left panel items Enhance market positioning and Strengthen longterm relationship; right panel items Robust mobile ordering platform, Own delivery fleet, Increase delivery hubs, Unlock scale efficiencies. The left-panel check badges are at about x 3-6%, y 56-67% and x 2.7-6%, y 67-73%; right-panel badges at x 69-72% at y 68.6, 77.0, 83.8 and 89.8 percent. 8) Small duplicate picture fragments of the ring arrowheads at about x 43-49%, y 20-25% (yellow) and x 48-54%, y 80-86% (tan), overlapping the ring.

### Slide 47

**Text**

Food On The Go | Drive-thru stores have witnessed increased adoption / westlife / Case example: Bharuch / SSSG (%) / Apr-20 / May-20 / Jun-20 / Jul-20 / Aug-20 / Sep-20 / Oct-20 / Nov-20 / Dec-20 / Jan-21 / Feb-21 / Mar-21 / Drive-thru / High-street / Food-Court/Mall / Drive-thru stores led the / recovery path vs high-street and mall/food-court / stores / Ahmednagar / ~40% / Higher than / system / Valsad / Average Daily Sales / 2016 / 2017 / 2018 / 2019 / 2021 / 2022 / Bharuch / System / Bharuch / 47

**Layout**

Two-column grid on a white slide. The title sits top-left across two lines, with the Westlife logo at top right. The left column holds two stacked line charts, each in a tan-outlined panel with a grey tab label at its top-left. The centre column holds a yellow callout box above a white box containing ~40% and text. The right column stacks three photographs, each with a yellow caption bar along its bottom edge. A thin yellow rule runs along the top edge and a thicker yellow rule along the bottom edge. The page number sits bottom right. Left margin is about 3.5% and right margin about 0.5% of slide width.

**Visuals**

Chart 1 (top left): line chart titled SSSG (%), in a tan-outlined panel. X-axis: monthly categories Apr-20 to Mar-21, labels rotated vertically. Y-axis: no visible tick labels or units, so values are not printed. Series: Drive-thru (red #D00000, thick), High-street (yellow-orange #FFBC0D), Food-Court/Mall (pale green #C5E5B5). All three rise from about the same low at Apr-20 to a late sharp climb in Feb-21 to Mar-21, where Drive-thru ends highest, about the same as High-street. Gridline at mid-height. Legend at bottom centre in one row: red line Drive-thru, yellow line High-street, pale green line Food-Court/Mall. No highlighted points.
Chart 2 (bottom left): line chart titled Average Daily Sales, in a tan-outlined panel. X-axis: years 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022 (2020 omitted), labels rotated vertically. Y-axis: no tick labels or units. Series: Bharuch (red #C8102E line) starts low, about 2016 at the lower level, crosses the System line about 2018, and levels off near the top about 2021 to 2022. System (green #70AD47 line) starts higher, about 2016, and rises gently to level at about 2021 to 2022 at a mid-high level. Legend at bottom: red line Bharuch, green line System. Green circle with white check mark and blue tick sits at top right of the chart, overlapping the panel border (icon).
Callout (centre): yellow box with text Drive-thru stores led the recovery path vs high-street and mall/food-court stores. Phrase 'Drive-thru stores led the recovery path' is bold.
Stat box (centre-lower): white box with thin yellow border reading ~40% in large red bold, then Higher than system in black regular.
Photographs (right column, all rectangular, not cropped to a shape, full-width of their column): top, McDonald's store at Ahmednagar, red and white facade with yellow arches sign on a red tower, McCafe sign, McDonald's wordmark and Gujarati-script name; overcast grey sky; cars and motorbikes in front; yellow and black kerb stripes; daylight, soft; yellow caption bar at bottom right labelled Ahmednagar. Middle, McDonald's store at Valsad, red tower, dark-brown roofline with yellow-lit signage, lamp posts, green lawn and kerb, overcast sky, daylight; yellow caption bar at bottom right labelled Valsad. Bottom, McDonald's drive-thru at Bharuch, brown-and-grey slatted facade, red roof band, flowering planters, brick pavement, blue-sky overcast, daylight; yellow caption bar at bottom right labelled Bharuch. Captions are black bold on yellow #FFBC0D bars.
Logo (top right): Westlife logo, green and purple leaf mark above the lowercase word westlife in dark grey.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title 'Food On The Go |' in red #C00000 regular, followed by bold black 'Drive-thru stores have witnessed increased adoption'. Subtitle 'Case example: Bharuch' in olive green #A9C23F regular. Typeface is Speedee, a rounded geometric sans-serif, regular and bold weights. Title text is about 4.8% of slide height (cap height about 3.4%); subtitle about 5.4%; body and chart labels about 2.2% to 3.3%. Accent colours are yellow #FFBC0D (top and bottom rules, caption bars, Valsad/Bharuch tabs) and red #DB0007 for ~40%. Panels are outlined in tan #C8B49A, with thin hairline borders and square corners. Grey tab labels #8A8A8D with white bold text. Callout fill #FFE49E with a thin darker yellow-tan border. Stat box white with thin yellow #FFBC0D border. No shadows or gradients.

**Layout**

Single-slide content layout on a white field with a thin yellow rule along the top and bottom edges. The title runs across the top-left at about 6% from the top with a 3.5% left margin, and the Westlife logo sits in the top-right corner. The left column holds the bulleted text and a boxed call-out, while the right column stacks two bar charts, the upper Speed of Service chart and the lower Estimated McDonald’s Drive Thrus chart. Source line sits bottom-left at about 96.5% and page number bottom-right at about 97%.

**Visuals**

Two bar charts and one boxed call-out, plus a Westlife logo. Chart 1: Speed of Service, secs; vertical bars with no printed values except the arrow label -70%. Bar 2019 is yellow and about 100 units tall; bar Current is red and about 30 units tall (relative heights, estimated). A yellow elbow arrow runs from the top of the 2019 bar right then down to the Current bar with a -70% label above it. Category labels 2019 and Current sit beneath the baseline. Chart 2: Estimated McDonald’s Drive Thrus stores, %; nine vertical yellow bars ordered ascending left to right, with the first bar (India (W&S)) red. Values printed above each bar: India (W&S) 20%, Brazil 45%, Japan 50%, UK 60%, France 70%, Germany 70%, Canada 75%, Australia 80%, USA 95%. Category labels are rotated 90 degrees beneath the baseline. No legend, no axis scale, no gridlines. Highlighted points: red India (W&S) bar and red -70% Current bar. Call-out: a white rectangle with a thin yellow outline holding the red figure 30-35% above the text New stores likely to be Drive Thrus. Logo: Westlife wordmark in dark serif with a multicoloured leaf emblem (green, purple, blue) above the right of the word.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Title red #C00000 for the lead-in and black #000000 bold for the main phrase. Body text black #000000, regular and bold weights. Chart headings bold grey #555555 with a smaller regular unit. Accents yellow #FFBC0D for the top and bottom rules, bars and call-out outline; red #C00000 and #C8161D for highlights. Typeface Speedee, a custom geometric grotesque sans-serif, with bold and regular and italic weights. Title size about 5.2% of slide height; body text about 3.7%; chart labels about 2.2%; footer about 1.8%. Lines are thin, flat, with no shadows, gradients or rounded corners. Chart heading rules are light tan #C8B08E with darker ends, partly covered by a 58% white overlay.

### Slide 51

**Review notes**

- Review: The deck has a clear route: a Vision 2022 scorecard on slides 6 and 7, five success drivers, market context, then Vision 2027 with a repeating four-pillar divider (slides 21, 22, 35, 51, 69) that keeps an 84-page investor deck navigable.

**Text**

DESSERTS (photo signage) / Take Away (photo signage) / westlife / Vision / 2027 / 01 / Meals Strategy / Achieve market leadership in core day parts through brand relevance / led by menu innovation and marketing / 02 / Omnichannel Strategy / Integrate various channels and touchpoints to a One McDonald’s / platform in order to provide consumers a seamless experience / 03 / Faster than ever Network Expansion / Penetrate unserved geographies and fortify existing markets with / renewed aggression / 04 / Lead with performance / Targeting superior business performance and operating efficiency / through execution excellence / 51

**Layout**

Two-zone layout: a full-height photo panel occupies the left 44% of the slide with a large concave curved right edge, and a text column starts at about 48.8% of the width. Four numbered circles sit on the curved edge at about 35-41% x, spaced evenly down the slide, each aligned with a text block of heading plus two-line body on the right; a divider rule separates blocks 1-2, 2-3 and 3-4. The title 'Vision 2027' is left-aligned over the photo at about 2.7% from the left edge, the Westlife logo sits in the top-right corner, a thin amber bar runs along the top and bottom edges, and the page number '51' sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

1) Photograph: interior of a McDonald's restaurant at dusk-like low light, showing a dessert counter with a yellow McDonald's 'M' golden arch logo and the word 'DESSERTS' in white capitals on the upper left, a small 'Take Away' sign with a yellow M near centre, warm wooden bench seating and dark foliage/plants in the lower half, and an overhead light cluster at top. Composition is a portrait crop, full-height, cropped at the left and right by the curved panel; lighting is warm and low, dominant colours are dark brown and black with yellow-gold highlights. The photo is overlaid with a gold/amber tint (about #B8900F at roughly 75% opacity) that makes it read as gold-brown, and its right edge is a large convex-to-the-right arc cut (about 60% of the slide height reaches the arc's widest point near x 41%). 2) Logo: Westlife logo at top right, a stylised leaf/swoosh icon with green, purple and magenta segments above a black lowercase serif wordmark 'westlife'. 3) Four circular number badges 01, 02, 03, 04 each a dark slate disc with a gold crescent offset behind it at lower right, white bold numerals. 4) A pale yellow right-pointing chevron/arrow block behind item 03 with a pointed right end. 5) Three thin light grey horizontal rules across the text column. 6) Thin amber/yellow bars along the top and bottom edges of the slide.

**Design**

Background is plain white. Titles and body text are black #000000. Accents: slate badges #405666 with gold crescents about #E0A800, highlight chevron #FFE49E, top and bottom bars amber about #FFB81C, page number grey #7F7F7F. Typeface is Speedee, a geometric rounded-terminal sans-serif; headings in Speedee Bold, body and numbers in Speedee Regular/Bold. Title 'Vision 2027' is very large at about 13.3% of slide height per line, numbers 6.7%, item headings 3.7%, body 2.6%, page number 1.8%. Shapes are flat with no visible shadows except a soft grey drop shadow beneath the photo panel edge; rules are hairlines about 0.1% of height, light grey #D9D9D9.

Five step-up bars sit on a single thin black baseline across the full width, in ascending order from left to right, with the tallest bar (160) in the fourth position and a shorter final bar (43). The title is top-left at about x 3.5%, y 6%, spanning most of the width. The Westlife logo is in the top-right corner. Period labels and bold captions sit in a row under the baseline, one per bar, centred on each bar; the footnote is bottom-right and the page number is at the bottom-right corner.

**Visuals**

Bar chart of restaurant counts by period, drawn as five adjacent rectangles with no axis, no gridlines, no scale and no legend. Bar 1: 17 restaurants, pale yellow, 1996 - 2002, 7 years. Bar 2: 68 restaurants, light yellow, 2003 - 2009, 7 years. Bar 3: 70 restaurants, bright amber, 2010 - 2012, 3 years, with a tan down-arrow and the italic label 'Became a DL' above it. Bar 4: 160 restaurants, dark gold, 2013 - 2019, 7 years. Bar 5: 43 restaurants, olive green, 2020 – 2022 YTD, 3 years, with a speech bubble reading 'Kept up with investments, despite Covid years' whose tail points at the top of this bar. Bar heights are relative and not scaled to a printed axis, so no values are printed for heights. Each bar carries a double-headed horizontal arrow near the baseline with its duration label in the middle. Arrows on bars 1 to 3 are black; arrows on bars 4 and 5 are white. The Westlife logo (a multicolour leaf mark of green, purple and blue over the black serif wordmark 'westlife') is a raster image in the top-right corner.

**Design**

Title in heavy black Speedee-Bold sans-serif, about 5.9% of slide height, sentence case. Numbers in Speedee-Bold, about 6.7% to 14.8% of slide height, black on light bars and white on dark bars. Descriptive words in Speedee-Regular sans-serif about 3.3% of slide height. Period labels about 2.5% and bold captions about 2.6% of slide height. ### Slide 53

**Text**

Faster than ever Network Expansion / Right markets / Right real estate / Right capabilities / 53

**Layout**

Yellow frame with a white inner panel fills the slide, leaving a border of about 2% on the sides and about 3% at top and bottom. The title sits top-left, left-aligned at about 3.5% from the left edge and 7.7% from the top, with a single line. A three-segment circular cycle diagram is centred in the lower-middle of the panel, with the three labels and icons inside the segments. The slide number sits bottom-right on the yellow frame.

**Visuals**

Diagram: a circular cycle of three curved arc segments with arrowheads, each segment a sector of one ring. The gray segment (upper-left, from about 10 o'clock to 4 o'clock) is labelled 'Right markets' and carries a map-with-location-pins icon above its label. The tan/brown segment (upper-right, from 12 o'clock to 5 o'clock) is labelled 'Right real estate' and carries a storefront icon above its label. The green segment (bottom, from 7 o'clock to 2 o'clock) is labelled 'Right capabilities' and carries a laptop icon showing a pie chart, bar/line graph and document above its label. The arcs run clockwise with arrowheads at the ends of each segment: the gray arrowhead points up-right at the top, the brown arrowhead points down-right at the lower right, and the green arrowhead points left at the lower left. Icons: a black line-and-solid map with three location pins and a small chat/bubble above it (map icon); a black line storefront with striped awning and door (store icon); a black line laptop screen with pie chart, document and line graph (laptop/analytics icon). Icons are solid black line art, all on white or coloured arcs. Ghost text: faint 'Right' and 'markets' in grey, tan and green lie behind the bold labels, offset slightly, as an unfilled duplicate of the labels.

**Design**

Background: Solid yellow #FFBC0D frame around a solid white #FFFFFF inner panel.

### Slide 54

**Text**

Right Markets / South presents a compelling case for higher investments / westlife / Same stores AUV: South / vs System / ~90% / ~75% / FY16 / Current / Right to win in / South with growing / product relevance / led by chicken / ~60% / New stores likely / to be in South / Store Split / 40% / 40% / 45-50% / 60% / 60% / 50-55% / FY16 / Current / Vision / West / South / South Towns potential / 60-65 / 25 / Current / Potential / Need to Accelerate / growth in a currently / underpenetrated / South market / 54

**Layout**

Single 16:9 content slide with a bold title across the top at the left margin and the Westlife logo in the top-right corner. The body is three columns: left column of two text blocks, centre column with two stacked bar charts separated by a thin vertical yellow divider, and right column with a boxed headline statistic above a stacked column chart. A yellow tag sits at top-left above the title, thin yellow rules run along the top and bottom edges, and the slide number 54 sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Four charts and one callout box. (1) Top-centre bar chart titled 'Same stores AUV: South vs System' with two columns labelled FY16 (gold #FFBC0D, labelled ~75%, about 75 on the value scale) and Current (red #DB0007, labelled ~90%). A thin gold arrow (#FFBC0D, about 1 pt line with arrowhead) rises diagonally from above the FY16 bar to above the Current bar. Baseline is a light grey horizontal line. No axes or legend are printed. (2) Lower-centre bar chart titled 'South Towns potential' with two columns: Current (gold, labelled 25) and Potential (red, labelled 60-65). A gold arrow with arrowhead rises diagonally from the Current bar to the Potential bar. Baseline light grey. (3) Right-hand 100% stacked column chart titled 'Store Split' with three columns FY16, Current and Vision. Each column is split into a gold West segment at the bottom and a red South segment at the top. FY16: West 60% gold, South 40% red. Current: West 60%, South 40%. Vision: West 50-55% gold, South 45-50% red; the Vision red segment is labelled 45-50% and the gold segment 50-55%. Thin grey connector lines run horizontally across the tops of the FY16 and Current columns and from the top of the FY16 column? no: a grey line joins the top of the FY16 column to the top of the Current column at the 100 level, a grey line joins the FY16/Current boundary at the West-South split across to Current, and a grey diagonal line runs from the Current West-South boundary down to the Vision West-South boundary. Labels are in small white-grey rectangles on each segment. Legend below the chart: gold square labelled West and red square labelled South. (4) Callout box with a thin gold outline (#FFBC0D, about 1 pt) containing red '~60%' and black text 'New stores likely to be in South'; no fill.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background (#FFFFFF). Title black (#000000) heavy geometric sans-serif (Speedee Bold), about 5.9% of slide height. Body text black (#000000) Speedee Regular about 4.4% of slide height, with bold lead-ins. Chart titles dark grey (#595959) Speedee Bold about 3.1%. Chart labels dark grey (#595959 or #404040) Speedee Regular about 2.2-2.6%. Accent colours: gold/yellow #FFBC0D for the top and bottom rules, the Right Markets tag, the vertical divider, the callout outline, the West series and the arrows; red #DB0007 for the South series and the ~60% headline (rendered #C8161D). Top and bottom rules are about 0.4% and 1% of slide height. The yellow tag has rounded bottom corners with black Speedee Bold text. Bars are flat with no shadows or gradients. Callout outline is square-cornered.

**Layout**

Full-bleed white slide with a thin yellow bar along the top and bottom edges. The bold title sits top-left at the margin with the green subtitle directly beneath it, and the Westlife logo sits top-right. Below the header, two bordered line charts stack in the left column (about x 2.8 to 50 percent). Two yellow callout boxes sit in a centre column (about x 50.6 to 70.7 percent), with a red-figure stat box to the right and a check icon beside the lower chart. The slide number is bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Two line charts plus a check icon. Chart 1 is a line chart titled 'Comparable Sales (%)' with a grey label tab. Its x-axis runs monthly from Apr-20 to Mar-21 with rotated labels; the y-axis has no printed values or units, only one faint horizontal gridline near the middle. Series 1, 'Small/Emerging', is a dark red #C8161D line starting at about the lowest point, rising steadily with a dip around Feb-21 and a sharp rise to the top at Mar-21 (about values, not printed). Series 2, 'Metros/ T1', is a yellow #FFB81C line running just below the red line throughout and ending near the top at Mar-21. The legend sits below the axis with a red dash for Small/Emerging and a yellow dash for Metros/ T1. No highlighted points. Chart 2 is a smooth line chart titled 'Average Daily Sales' with a grey label tab. Its x-axis shows 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022 in rotated labels; the y-axis has no printed values or units and one faint baseline gridline near the bottom. Series 'Raipur' is a yellow #FFB81C curve that dips in 2017, rises to a peak around 2021 and eases slightly at 2022 (about values). Series 'Bhilai & Bilaspur' is a red #C8161D line with a marker at its start, starting at about 2021 near the baseline and rising steeply to the top right at 2022 (about values). Series 'System' is a green #70AD47 curve that rises gently from 2016 and flattens near the top at 2022 (about values). The legend sits below with yellow for Raipur, red with a blue dot marker for Bhilai & Bilaspur, and green for System. Icon: a green #4CAF50 filled circle with a white-to-blue #2196F3 check mark, sited at the top-right of the Average Daily Sales chart, overlapping the chart frame edge. Callout boxes are plain text panels on yellow fill with no icons. Stat box: an outlined rectangle with a yellow #FFC000 hairline border containing large red text. Logo: the Westlife leaf mark in purple, magenta and green, with black serif wordmark 'westlife' at top-right.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White #FFFFFF background. Thin yellow #FFB81C bars at the top and bottom edges, each about 0.4 percent of slide height. A small yellow #FFB81C rounded tag behind the 'Right Markets' label in black bold sans. Title in bold sans-serif (Speedee-Bold style, close to a humanist sans like Frutiger Black) in black #000000 at about 5.4 percent of slide height. Subtitle in regular sans (Speedee-Regular style) in olive green #A9C23F at the same size. Chart header tabs are grey #8A8A8D rectangles with white bold sans text at about 2.6 percent of slide height. Chart axis and legend labels are regular sans in grey #595959 at about 2.6 percent; chart 2 axis labels are Calibri in black. Callout text is bold and regular sans in black #000000 at about 3.3 percent of slide height. Callout boxes are flat yellow #FFE49E fills with thin tan #C9A66B borders, square corners, no shadow. Stat box has a thin #FFC000 outline with white fill, square corners. Stat figure is bold sans in red #C8161D at about 6.7 percent of slide height. Chart frames are thin tan #B5967A outlines, square corners, no shadow. Slide number is small grey #7F7F7F regular sans.

Left alignment on a 3.5% left margin for title and labels, with the Westlife logo in the top-right corner and a yellow tag at top-left.

**Visuals**

Table: a comparison grid with 3 columns (row label, Smaller Store (Delivery focused), Standard Store (Omnichannel)) and 9 data rows. Header row (yellow): Smaller Store / (Delivery focused) and Standard Store / (Omnichannel). Row 1 Store size: ~2000 sq. ft. | 3000-3500 sq. ft. Row 2 Capex: INR ~25 mn | INR 32-40 mn. Row 3 Seating Capacity: ~40-50 | 100-120. Blank spacer row. Row 4 Avg Unit Volume: Rs. 40-50 mn | Rs. 70-80 mn. Row 5 Estimated SSSG: 5-7% | 7-9%. Blank banded row. Row 6 ROM: High in Short term | High in Long-term, with a pale gold check-circle icon under the Smaller column and a green check-circle icon under the Standard column. Row 7 blank banded row with the same icon placement under ROM. Row 8 ROCE: High in Short term | High in Long-term, with a pale gold check-circle under Smaller and a green check-circle under Standard. Icons: 4 small check-circle icons, two pale gold (#F3D27E-ish, with a blue tick) under Smaller Store and two green (#2EAE4B with blue tick) under Standard Store. Logo: Westlife emblem (purple and green leaf/swoosh) above black serif wordmark 'westlife'. No charts or photographs. Callout box is text only, with a yellow outline around the sentence.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the full slide. Clean corporate slide on white. Title is bold black Speedee-style geometric sans-serif (closest: Futura/Gotham-like bold sans) at about 5.9% of slide height. Subtitle 'Key business model differentiators' is bold red sans at about 3.7%. Table header row is solid yellow #FFBC0D with bold black column titles and regular subtitles; body rows alternate light grey #E7E7E7 and white; thick black horizontal rules bound the table top, below the header, and bottom, plus a thin divider between table columns. Body text is regular black sans at about 2.96% of slide height. The right panel is a flat warm light grey #F0EBE6 with square corners, no shadow, bullets in black Wingdings squares and check marks. Accent red #C00000 for the heading, #DB0007 for the highlighted phrase. Yellow tag at top-left has rounded corners. Yellow thin rules at top and bottom edges. Footnote is regular black at about 2.05%. Page number is grey #7F7F7F at about 1.8%.

**Review notes**

- What would change the score: I would raise the smallest chart labels and body text on slides 10 to 12, 18 and 57 to a size readable in a room, and reduce text on the densest slides to one message each.

**Text**

Right Capabilities / Superior real estate capabilities to lead the execution / Team Size / Store Pipeline / Globally consistent and tested methodology to / identify unserved markets / 1.4x / 1.9x / 1.2x / 1.x / Technical / 1.x / Identify trade areas by leveraging / external data like socio economic / metrics (population, urbanization etc.), / competition, 3PO etc. / Build long-term relationships / Empirical / FY16 / Central / Line / FY16 / Current / ➢ / Renewed leases of 7 marquee stores opened / between 1996 and 2002 with same landlord / and location / Create iconic retail centers / Correlate the trade areas with internal / benchmarks (Overlap, ROI etc.) and / Validation / proprietary demand generation data / ➢ / Ability to envision and build retail ecosystem / around stores thereby creating new / landmarks over long-term / Continuous micro market study / ➢ / Regular revalidation of retail landscape for all / Post office validation, Real Estate / Planning team along with external real / estate experts validate the potential / Prioritization / stores through extensive trade area study / store location sites on field / and robust consumer surveys / Prioritization based on business / strategy, profitability, real estate deals, / supply chain, delivery dark spots, and / competition gaps amongst others / 57 / Proposed Site

**Layout**

Two-column body under a full-width title. The title Superior real estate capabilities to lead the execution sits top-left at about 5 percent from the top, with the Westlife logo at top-right and a yellow Right Capabilities tag above it at top-left. The left column holds a brown header box over four stacked process rows (Technical, Empirical, Validation, Prioritization) with arrows between them, each row with text and an image. The right column holds two small bar charts side by side (Team Size, Store Pipeline) above three check-mark bullet points. A yellow rule runs along the top and bottom edges; slide number 57 sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Four-step process diagram in the left column: four tan rectangles stacked vertically, each joined to the next by a downward block arrow pointing down. Each rectangle has a white bold label. Beside each step is a description and an image. Images: (1) Technical: a map of India in green shades with a red state highlighted, a small legend and caption at the lower right, boxed, no crop; (2) Empirical: a colourful map with circles and red, green and blue radial lines over a pale base map, rounded-corner box; (3) Validation: a street photograph of a building with a red outlined site rectangle and a yellow arrow, caption Proposed Site, two motorbikes at left, trees above, daylight, rounded-corner box; (4) Prioritization: a flat icon of a looping arrow connecting three numbered rounded boxes, 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Right column charts: Team Size is a column chart with no axis lines values shown: FY16 bar yellow #FFBC0D labelled 1.x, Central bar red #DB0007 labelled 1.2x, Line bar red #DB0007 labelled 1.4x; about the Line bar is about 1.4 times the FY16 bar height. Store Pipeline is a column chart: FY16 bar yellow #FFBC0D labelled 1.x, Current bar red #DB0007 labelled 1.9x; bars share a baseline. Heading rules: thin tan lines either side of each chart heading. Three green #4CAF50 circles with white-and-blue check marks sit beside the bullet headings; each bullet has a Wingdings arrow glyph. A small red dot sits near the second check mark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF.

### Slide 58

**Text**

We’ve identified an opportunity to extend our market / leadership by adding 250-300 stores in the next 5 years / No. of stores / 250 - / 300 / Renewed aggression with an / aim to scale to / 580-630 stores by 2027 / 580 - / 630 / 337 / Current store base / Additional stores / Stores by 2027 / Pace of store addition / 40 - / 55 / 24 / 23 / FY10-16 / FY16-22* / Next 5y / 337 / Current / 580-630 / 5 years / >1000 / Long- / term / .. work on the next ~200 stores has already / commenced / *normalizing the impact of pandemic / 58

**Layout**

Two-column grid on a white slide: the left half (about 0 to 54% of width) holds two stacked bar charts, each under a tan horizontal rule with a centred grey section label, and the right half (about 58 to 95%) holds a yellow-outlined callout box above a row of three overlapping circles and an italic caption. The title is left-aligned in two lines across the top from x 3.5%, y 3.4%, with the Westlife logo top-right at x 91.4%, y 0. The footnote sits bottom-left at x 6.2%, y 96.8%, and the page number 58 sits bottom-right at x 98.3%, y 97.0%. Thin yellow bars run along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

Two bar charts (waterfall style, column bars) and one circle-flow diagram. Chart 1 titled 'No. of stores', categories on x-axis: 'Current store base', 'Additional stores', 'Stores by 2027'. Bars: yellow #FFBC0D bar labelled 337 (current base); green #00B050 floating bar labelled 250 - 300 (additional stores), placed above the 337 bar level; red #DB0007 bar labelled 580 - 630 (stores by 2027), the tallest bar, reaching the top of the green bar. Thin grey #D9D9D9 connector lines link bar tops between steps. No numeric axes are printed; the bars are unlabelled by scale. Chart 2 titled 'Pace of store addition', categories on x-axis: 'FY10-16', 'FY16-22*', 'Next 5y'. Bars: yellow bar labelled 24 (FY10-16); green bar labelled 23 (FY16-22*); red bar labelled 40 - 55 (Next 5y), the tallest bar. No value axis or scale is printed; bar heights are not labelled beyond the printed values. Footnote marker * refers to '*normalizing the impact of pandemic'. Diagram: three overlapping circles left to right: first circle (grey #8A8A8D outline, light grey #F2F2F2 fill) labelled 337 / Current; second circle (sage #84A38C outline, near-white fill) labelled 580-630 / 5 years; third circle (tan #B69A81 outline, warm off-white fill) labelled >1000 / Long-term. A grey arrow-pointer (#8A8A8D) connects circle 1 to circle 2 and a sage arrow-pointer (#84A38C) connects circle 2 to circle 3, pointing rightwards. Circle 3 sits on a pale grey #F2F2F2 square backdrop at 50% opacity. Logo: Westlife leaf mark (purple, green and yellow leaf shapes) above the black serif wordmark 'westlife', raster image 236 by 159 px. A placed raster image (1352 by 551 px) occupies the upper-left chart area, unboxed and uncropped.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate white slide with yellow #FFBC0D top and bottom edge bars. Titles in heavy black sans-serif (Speedee-Bold, geometric grotesque) at about 5.6% of slide height, black #000000. Body and labels in regular-weight sans-serif at about 3.5 to 4.4% of slide height in black #000000; chart value labels bold, white on green and red bars and black on yellow bars. Section labels bold grey #555555. Axis labels grey #555555 or #595959 at about 2.6% of slide height. Accent colours: red #DB0007 and #C8161D for emphasis text, green #00B050, yellow #FFBC0D, tan #B69A81 rules and circle outline, sage #84A38C, grey #8A8A8D. Callout box has a yellow #FFBC0D 1-pt outline and rounded corners of about 1.5% of slide height radius, white fill. Rules are 0.4% high tan lines. Circles have thick outlines of about 0.6% of slide height. No shadows or gradients.

Four green circular check icons, one beside each left-hand bullet, each a solid green disc (about #4CAF50) with a blue (about #2196F3) check mark stroke. Nine dark brown (#624D39) rectangular label boxes with white bold text, each about 7.5% to 9% of width and 10.5% of height, evenly spaced in one row. Top-right Westlife logo: a purple and green leaf mark above the lowercase wordmark 'westlife' in black serif type.

**Visuals**

Eight head-and-shoulders portrait photographs in a 4-column by 2-row grid, each in a chamfered-corner frame (top-left and bottom-right corners cut diagonally) with a thin gold outline. Row 1: B. L. Jatia, older man with grey hair in dark suit, blue tie, white shirt, neutral expression, plain grey background; Amit Jatia, smiling man in dark suit and lilac tie against a white wall; Smita Jatia, smiling woman with long dark wavy hair in a red and orange top against a dark background; Akshay Jatia, smiling bearded man in navy blazer and open white collar against a grey background. Row 2: Tarun Kataria, smiling grey-haired man in dark suit and pink tie against a pale grey-white background; P. R. Photos are boxed, not full-bleed, with even soft studio lighting. Westlife logo: a purple and green leaf mark above the black serif wordmark westlife. Four tan rectangular tag boxes (#B69A81) with white bold text. Four short purple horizontal rules under the designations. Thin yellow bars at top and bottom edges.

**Layout**

Full-width white slide with a bold title at top left and a westlife logo at top right; a thin yellow rule runs along the top and bottom edges. The main body is a three-column grid: Environmental cards (four columns of small cards under a green banner) on the left, Social cards (two columns under a gold banner) in the centre, and a vertical yellow NEXT PHASE panel on the right, with the Governance row of six tan boxes along the bottom left and the Sustainable procurement and Inclusion strips beside it. Slide number 80 sits bottom right.

**Visuals**

Icons and logos: a green lightbulb with leaves beneath the ENVIRONMENTAL banner; three pale-gold people silhouettes at the SOCIAL banner; a black NEXT PHASE arrow banner; a yellow lightbulb icon beside Electricity (83,26,020 units); an orange-red diesel pump icon beside Diesel; a red gas cylinder icon beside Gas; a green circular fuel icon beside 6,40,000 liters of biodiesel produced; a green recycling-symbol icon beside 23,000 kilograms of plastic recycled; a green water drop icon beside 1,75,20,000 liters of water saved; a green lightbulb icon with leaf beside Electricity 1,70,000 units; a red-and-green hands icon beside 75,000 meals; a red heart-in-hands icon beside 36,500 lives touched; a syringe icon beside 100% vaccination; a presenter-at-whiteboard icon beside ~10,000 employees trained; the McDonald's golden-arches logo beside Sourced only Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certified paper for packaging; the EatQual logo (purple text on yellow pill) beside Improvement in brand scores. The NEXT PHASE panel contains five white rounded boxes with black outlines connected by four light-yellow down arrows. A black right-pointing triangle sits between the Social column and the NEXT PHASE panel. No charts or tables.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF.

Bottom-left: a cog-shaped gear enclosing a person silhouette, with dotted lines running to a bar chart whose three bars rise and end in an upward arrow. Bottom-right: three people silhouettes above a handshake, with a cog behind them. 83

**Layout**

Full-slide layout with a dark translucent panel on the left roughly 24% of the width holding a centred stacked statement, and the framework graphic occupying the right ~83% of the slide between about x 14.5% and 97.3%. There is no conventional title placeholder: the title 'Accelerating the Arches' sits at the top of the graphic's yellow header band, left-aligned to the strategic goal line beneath it. Content is organised as horizontal stacked bands (header, Purpose and Mission pair, five-column Values row, four-column Growth Pillars row, Foundation footer band) with the red arch forming a curved left edge. Westlife logo sits top right; McDonald's logo sits bottom right; slide number bottom right; thin yellow rules run along the top and bottom edges.

**Visuals**

One framework graphic (placed image, 1351 by 853 px, at x 14.5% y 5.3% w 82.8% h 92.5%) with no photographs. It shows a stylised red arch (a C-shaped red band with a large swoosh at top right and bottom right, and a red vertical tab at top-left and bottom-left) enclosing horizontal yellow (#FEBA0D) bands: header band containing the title and strategic goal; a pair of bands labelled Our Purpose (left) and Our Mission (right) separated by a white gap; a band labelled Our Values with five columns separated by thin dark vertical rules; a band labelled Our Growth Pillars with three pillar columns each marked by a red square badge (letters M, C, D) with a short black tab beneath and a thin vertical connector line dropping to the bullet list; a Foundation band at the bottom with a list. The left 24% of the slide is covered by a black overlay at 64% opacity, which turns the underlying red to a deep maroon, and a dark olive-gold curved stroke (a sweeping S-shaped ribbon, about x 15% to 22%, y 37% to 68%) is visible through that overlay behind the statement text. Westlife logo: a purple-to-green leaf-like mark above the black serif wordmark 'westlife', top right. McDonald's logo: a golden double-arch M on a red rounded square, bottom right.

**Design**

Background white (#FFFFFF) with yellow (#FEBA0D) horizontal bands and red (#DA0000) arch shapes. Title 'Accelerating the Arches' and value/pillar headings in bold red #DA0000 (approximately #E00000 for headings, #C8161D for Foundation label). Body text black #000000 for purpose and mission statements and #262626 for values, pillars and bullets. Statement text on the left is white #FFFFFF. Typefaces: Speedee (McDonald's brand face), a geometric humanist sans-serif; Speedee-Bold for headings and emphasis, Speedee-Regular for body. Title size about 6.3% of slide height (heavy); strategic goal and pillar bullets about 1.8 to 2.6%; value body text about 1.9%; overlay statement about 5.9% per line. Line and shape style: flat fills, no outlines, sharp rectangles for bands with curved red swooshes, no shadows, no gradients. Small thin dark vertical divider rules in the Values and Growth bands. Slide number grey #7F7F7F.
